ko.title: AI 붐의 동력: 데이터 센터가 전기 요금 인상의 원인으로 지목되는 이유

segments.src: Electricity used to be one of the most predictable lines in a household budget.
segments.tr: 전기 요금은 가계 예산에서 가장 예측하기 쉬운 항목 중 하나였습니다.

segments.src: In many parts of the United States, that is changing.
segments.tr: 미국 내 많은 지역에서 이러한 상황이 변하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Retail power prices have risen faster than general inflation in recent years, and the rapid growth of data centers, the facilities that run cloud computing and artificial intelligence, is one of the reasons analysts and regulators keep pointing to.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년 동안 주택용·상업용 전력 가격이 일반 물가상승률보다 빠르게 올랐으며, 클라우드 컴퓨팅과 인공지능을 구동하는 시설인 데이터 센터의 급격한 증가는 분석가들과 규제 기관들이 지속적으로 지목하는 원인 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: This explainer walks through how that cost can travel from a server hall to a monthly bill, and what policymakers are doing about it.
segments.tr: 이 해설서에서는 데이터 센터의 비용이 어떻게 서버실에서 월간 청구서로 전달되는지, 그리고 정책 입안자들이 이에 대해 어떤 조치를 취하고 있는지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *본 문서는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 재정적 또는 법적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.tr: 수치는 대략적인 값이며 지역 및 연도에 따라 다릅니다.*

segments.src: ## Why data centers matter to the grid
segments.tr: ## 데이터 센터가 전력망에 중요한 이유

segments.src: For about fifteen years, U.S.
segments.tr: 약 15년 동안 미국의

segments.src: electricity demand was nearly flat, because efficiency gains offset population and economic growth.
segments.tr: 전력 수요는 거의 정체되어 있었습니다. 에너지 효율 개선이 인구 증가와 경제 성장을 상쇄했기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Utilities and grid operators planned around that stability.
segments.tr: 전력 회사와 전력망 운영자들은 이러한 안정성을 바탕으로 계획을 수립했습니다.

segments.src: Large data centers break that pattern.
segments.tr: 대형 데이터 센터는 이러한 패턴을 깨뜨립니다.

segments.src: A single big campus can require as much power as a small city, and it can ask for that power within a few years.
segments.tr: 단 하나의 대규모 단지가 소도시 하나와 맞먹는 전력을 필요로 할 수 있으며, 몇 년 내에 해당 전력을 공급해 달라고 요청할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Grid planners in several regions, including parts of Virginia, Texas, Ohio, Georgia and the Mid-Atlantic, have sharply raised their demand forecasts.
segments.tr: 버니지아, 텍사스, 오하이오, 조지아 및 중부 대서양 일부 지역을 포함한 여러 지역의 전력망 계획자들은 수요 예측을 대폭 상향 조정했습니다.

segments.src: Power plants and transmission lines, by contrast, take years to permit and build.
segments.tr: 반면 발전소와 송전선은 인허가를 받고 건설하는 데 수년이 걸립니다.

segments.src: When demand grows faster than supply, power becomes scarcer and costlier.
segments.tr: 수요가 공급보다 빠르게 증가하면 전력은 희소해지고 비용이 비싸집니다.

segments.src: That is the basic economic pressure behind the headlines.
segments.tr: 이것이 뉴스의 헤드라인 뒤에 숨은 기본적인 경제적 압박입니다.

segments.src: ## Not every price increase is caused by data centers
segments.tr: ## 모든 가격 인상이 데이터 센터 때문은 아닙니다

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: 이 부분은 신중하게 접근할 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: Electric bills rise for many reasons:
segments.tr: 전기 요금이 오르는 데는 여러 가지 이유가 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Natural gas prices**, which set wholesale power prices in many markets.
segments.tr: - **천연가스 가격**: 많은 시장에서 도매 전력 가격을 결정짓습니다.

segments.src: - **Aging infrastructure** that utilities must repair or replace.
segments.tr: - **노후화된 인프라**: 전력 회사가 수리하거나 교체해야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, especially in some western and coastal states.
segments.tr: - **산불, 폭풍 및 복구력 지출**: 특히 일부 서부 및 해안가 주에서 비중이 큽니다.

segments.src: - **Transmission upgrades** to connect new generation, including renewables.
segments.tr: - **송전망 보강**: 재생 에너지를 포함한 신규 발전을 연계하기 위함입니다.

segments.src: - **General inflation** in labor and equipment.
segments.tr: - **일반 물가상승**: 인건비 및 장비 비용 상승입니다.

segments.src: Data center demand is one factor among several, and its share differs from place to place.
segments.tr: 데이터 센터 수요는 여러 요인 중 하나일 뿐이며, 그 기여도는 지역마다 다릅니다.

segments.src: Studies from grid operators, consultants and consumer advocates reach different conclusions about how much it contributes.
segments.tr: 전력망 운영자, 컨설팅업체, 소비자 옹호 단체의 연구 결과는 그것이 얼마나 영향을 미치는지에 대해 서로 다른 결론을 내립니다.

segments.src: Treat any single number with caution.
segments.tr: 어느 하나의 단일 수치든 주의해서 다루어야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Channel one: capacity auctions
segments.tr: ## 전달 경로 1: 용량 입찰(Capacity auctions)

segments.src: In some regions, grid operators run auctions to make sure enough power plants will be available in future years, even if they only run at peak times.
segments.tr: 일부 지역에서는 전력망 운영자가 피크 시간에만 가동되더라도 향후 몇 년 동안 충분한 발전소를 확보할 수 있도록 경매를 실시합니다.

segments.src: The best-known example is PJM Interconnection, which serves 13 states and Washington, D.C., from Illinois to New Jersey.
segments.tr: 가장 잘 알려진 예는 일리노이부터 뉴저지까지 13개 주와 워싱턴 D.C.에 전력을 공급하는 PJM Interconnection입니다.

segments.src: Here is how it works in simple terms:
segments.tr: 간단히 작동 방식을 설명하자면 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. The grid operator forecasts peak demand for a future delivery year.
segments.tr: 1. 전력망 운영자는 향후 인도 연도의 최대 수요를 예측합니다.

segments.src: 2. Power plant owners and demand-response providers bid to promise their availability.
segments.tr: 2. 발전소 소유주와 수요 반응 사업자들은 전력 공급 가능성을 약속하며 입찰합니다.

segments.src: 3. The auction sets a single clearing price, usually quoted in dollars per megawatt-day, that all accepted resources receive.
segments.tr: 3. 경매를 통해 낙찰된 모든 자원이 받게 되는 단일 정산 가격(보통 메가와트-일당 달러 단위)이 결정됩니다.

segments.src: 4. Utilities, and the retail suppliers that serve customers, pay those costs and generally pass them through to customers.
segments.tr: 4. 전력 회사와 고객에게 전력을 공급하는 소매 공급업체는 이러한 비용을 지불하고 일반적으로 이를 고객에게 전가합니다.

segments.src: When forecast demand rises and supply is tight, clearing prices rise.
segments.tr: 예측 수요가 증가하고 공급이 부족해지면 정산 가격이 상승합니다.

segments.src: PJM's auction for the 2025/26 delivery year cleared at roughly $270 per megawatt-day, up from about $29 the year before.
segments.tr: 2025/26 인도 연도에 대한 PJM 경매는 전년도 약 $29에서 크게 오른 메가와트-일당 약 $270에 낙찰되었습니다.

segments.src: Later auctions for 2026/27 and 2027/28 cleared at the maximum price allowed under a temporary cap-and-floor arrangement, around $329 and $333 per megawatt-day.
segments.tr: 이후 진행된 2026/27 및 2027/28 연도 경매는 임시 캡앤플로어(상하한선) 협정에 따라 허용된 최대 가격인 메가와트-일당 약 $329 및 $333 수준에서 낙찰되었습니다.

segments.src: PJM and independent market monitors have cited data center load growth as a significant driver of the higher forecasts.
segments.tr: PJM과 독립 시장 감시 기관은 상승된 예측치의 주요 원인으로 데이터 센터의 부하 증가를 꼽았습니다.

segments.src: Because these charges are folded into bills as contracts and rates roll over, households often see the effect months after an auction, and in steps rather than all at once.
segments.tr: 이러한 비용은 계약 및 요금 갱신에 따라 청구서에 반영되므로, 가계에서는 경매가 끝난 지 몇 달 후, 그리고 한 번에 다 오르는 것이 아니라 단계적으로 영향을 느끼게 됩니다.

segments.src: ## Channel two: utility rate cases
segments.tr: ## 전달 경로 2: 전력 회사 요금 조정 신청(Rate cases)

segments.src: The second path runs through state utility regulators.
segments.tr: 두 번째 경로는 주 전력 규제 기관을 통하는 것입니다.

segments.src: Most households buy power from a regulated utility whose prices are set in a **rate case**, a formal proceeding in which the utility asks a public utility commission to approve the revenue it needs.
segments.tr: 대부분의 가계는 규제 대상 전력 회사로부터 전기를 구매하며, 이 가격은 전력 회사가 공공 규제 위원회에 필요한 수익 승인을 요청하는 공식 절차인 **요금 조정 신청(rate case)**을 통해 결정됩니다.

segments.src: Utilities earn a regulated return on the infrastructure they build, so new substations, transmission lines and generation can raise the revenue requirement.
segments.tr: 전력 회사는 자신들이 건설하는 인프라에 대해 규제된 수익을 얻으므로, 새로운 변전소, 송전선 및 발전 설비는 필요한 총수익 요건을 높일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If a utility builds for data center demand, the question becomes who pays:
segments.tr: 전력 회사가 데이터 센터 수요를 위해 설비를 건설할 경우, 비용을 누가 부담할 것인가가 문제가 됩니다:

segments.src: - If the data center pays for the full cost of serving it, other customers are largely protected.
segments.tr: - 데이터 센터가 전력 공급에 필요한 전액을 부담하면 다른 고객은 대체로 보호받습니다.

segments.src: - If costs are spread across all customers, and the expected data center load is delayed, smaller than promised, or leaves, ordinary ratepayers may be stuck with a share of the bill.
segments.tr: - 비용이 모든 고객에게 분산되고, 예상된 데이터 센터 부하가 지연되거나 약속보다 작거나 떠나버리면 일반 수용가가 비용의 일부를 떠안게 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That second scenario is the central worry.
segments.tr: 이 두 번째 시나리오가 핵심적인 우려 사항입니다.

segments.src: Regulators call it the risk of **stranded costs**, and consumer advocates argue it is a real risk because tech companies can change plans faster than a 30-year power plant can be retired.
segments.tr: 규제 기관은 이를 **좌초 비용(stranded costs)** 위험이라 부르며, 소비자 옹호 단체들은 테크 기업들이 30년 수명의 발전소가 폐쇄되는 것보다 빠르게 계획을 변경할 수 있기 때문에 이것이 실질적인 위험이라고 주장합니다.

segments.src: ## What regulators and states are doing
segments.tr: ## 규제 기관과 각 주 정부의 대응

segments.src: Policymakers have responded in several ways, and the approaches are still evolving.
segments.tr: 정책 입안자들은 여러 방식으로 대응해 왔으며, 접근 방식은 여전히 진화 중입니다.

segments.src: **Special rate classes for large users.** A number of states have approved or are considering tariffs for very large customers.
segments.tr: **대용량 사용자를 위한 전용 요금제.** 여러 주에서 매우 큰 규모의 수용가를 위한 요금제를 승인했거나 검토하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Typical features include long contract terms of 10 to 20 years, minimum monthly charges that apply whether or not the customer uses the power ("take-or-pay"), exit fees, and collateral requirements.
segments.tr: 주요 특징으로는 10년에서 20년에 이르는 장기 계약 기간, 고객의 실제 전력 사용 여부와 상관없이 적용되는 최소 월 요금("take-or-pay"), 중도 해지 수수료 및 담보 요건 등이 있습니다.

segments.src: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia and others have taken steps in this direction.
segments.tr: 오하이오, 인디애나, 조지아, 버지니아 등이 이러한 방향의 조치를 취했습니다.

segments.src: **Making large users bring their own power.** Some proposals encourage or require data centers to fund new generation, sign power purchase agreements, or use on-site generation, so that new demand comes with new supply.
segments.tr: **대용량 사용자의 자체 전력 확보 의무화.** 일부 제안은 데이터 센터가 신규 발전에 자금을 대거나, 전력 구매 계약(PPA)을 체결하거나, 구내 자가 발전을 사용하도록 장려하거나 의무화하여 신규 수요에 맞춰 신규 공급이 수반되도록 하고 있습니다.

segments.src: **Wholesale market reforms.** At the federal level, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been examining how large loads connect to the grid and how costs are assigned, including co-location of data centers at power plants.
segments.tr: **도매 시장 개혁.** 연방 차원에서 연방에너지규제위원회(FERC)는 데이터 센터의 발전소 내 인근 입지(co-location)를 포함하여 대규모 부하가 전력망에 연계되는 방식 및 비용 분배 방식을 검토해 왔습니다.

segments.src: PJM has also been revising its auction rules and load forecasting, and its price cap and floor were negotiated with state officials after complaints from governors.
segments.tr: PJM 또한 경매 규칙과 부하 예측을 개정해 왔으며, 가격 상하한선은 주지사들의 항의 이후 주 정부 관계자들과의 협상을 통해 조정되었습니다.

segments.src: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Because developers sometimes file overlapping requests for the same power, regulators are asking for firmer commitments and clearer data so utilities do not overbuild.
segments.tr: **예측 정확도 및 투명성 향상.** 개발자들이 때때로 동일한 전력에 대해 중복 요청을 제출하기 때문에, 규제 기관은 전력 회사가 과도하게 설비를 증설하지 않도록 더 확실한 확약과 명확한 데이터를 요구하고 있습니다.

segments.src: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Some utilities and researchers are exploring whether data centers can reduce use during peak hours, which would ease strain and reduce the need for new plants.
segments.tr: **효율성 및 유연성.** 일부 전력 회사와 연구자들은 데이터 센터가 피크 시간대 사용량을 줄일 수 있는지 모색하고 있으며, 이는 전력망 부담을 완화하고 신규 발전소의 필요성을 줄여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What households can do
segments.tr: ## 가계에서 할 수 있는 일

segments.src: You cannot control a capacity auction, but you can take practical steps:
segments.tr: 용량 경매를 직접 제어할 수는 없지만, 다음과 같은 실천적인 조치를 취할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Read your bill** to see the supply charge, delivery charge and any riders or surcharges.
segments.tr: - **청구서 확인하기**: 전력 공급 요금, 송배전 요금 및 기타 추가금이나 부과금을 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** In some states you can, but compare the price, contract length and fees carefully, and watch for teaser rates.
segments.tr: - **공급업체 선택 가능 여부 확인**: 일부 주에서는 공급업체를 선택할 수 있으나, 가격, 계약 기간 및 수수료를 주의 깊게 비교하고 초기의 미끼 요금에 주의하세요.

segments.src: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** and efficiency rebates from your utility.
segments.tr: - **계절별·시간대별 요금제(TOU)** 및 전력 회사의 효율성 환급금(리베이트)에 대해 문의하세요.

segments.src: - **Weatherize and upgrade** insulation, thermostats and appliances, which lowers use regardless of the rate.
segments.tr: - **단열, 온도 조절기, 가전제품을 보강 및 업그레이드**하여 요금 체계와 상관없이 사용량 자체를 줄이세요.

segments.src: - **Participate.** Utility commissions hold public comment periods on rate cases, and comments from customers are part of the record.
segments.tr: - **참여하기**: 공공사업위원회는 요금 조정 신청에 대해 공공 의견 수렴 기간을 가지며, 고객의 의견은 공식 기록의 일부가 됩니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The artificial intelligence boom is real, and so is its appetite for electricity.
segments.tr: 인공지능 붐은 현실이며, 전력에 대한 엄청난 식욕 역시 현실입니다.

segments.src: Whether it raises household bills depends on decisions still being made: how costs are allocated, how fast new supply is built, and how much risk shifts to the companies that benefit.

zh.title: 推动人工智能热潮：为什么数据中心会出现在你的电费账单上

segments.src: Electricity used to be one of the most predictable lines in a household budget.
segments.tr: 过去，电费是美国家庭预算中最具可预测性的支出之一。

segments.src: In many parts of the United States, that is changing.
segments.tr: 在美国的许多地区，这种情况正在改变。

segments.src: Retail power prices have risen faster than general inflation in recent years, and the rapid growth of data centers, the facilities that run cloud computing and artificial intelligence, is one of the reasons analysts and regulators keep pointing to.
segments.tr: 近年来，零售电力价格的上涨速度超过了整体通货膨胀，而运行云计算和人工智能的设施——数据中心的快速增长，是分析师和监管机构不断指出的原因之一。

segments.src: This explainer walks through how that cost can travel from a server hall to a monthly bill, and what policymakers are doing about it.
segments.tr: 本文将解释这些成本如何从服务器机房传导至每月的电费账单，以及政策制定者正在采取哪些应对措施。

segments.src: ## Why data centers matter to the grid
segments.tr: ## 为什么数据中心对电网如此重要

segments.src: For about fifteen years, U.S.
segments.tr: 在大约十五年的时间里，美国电力的需求几乎持平，因为效率的提升抵消了人口和经济的增长。

segments.src: electricity demand was nearly flat, because efficiency gains offset population and economic growth.
segments.tr: 电力公司和电网运营商一直围绕这种稳定性进行规划。

segments.src: Utilities and grid operators planned around that stability.
segments.tr: 大型数据中心打破了这一规律。

segments.src: Large data centers break that pattern.
segments.tr: 单个大型园区所需的电力可能相当于一个小型城市，而且它可能在短短几年内就提出这一用电需求。

segments.src: A single big campus can require as much power as a small city, and it can ask for that power within a few years.
segments.tr: 包括弗吉尼亚州、得克萨斯州、俄亥俄州、佐治亚州和大西洋中部部分地区在内的多个地区的电网规划人员，已经大幅调高了他们的需求预测。

segments.src: Grid planners in several regions, including parts of Virginia, Texas, Ohio, Georgia and the Mid-Atlantic, have sharply raised their demand forecasts.
segments.tr: 相比之下，发电厂和输电线路的审批和建设需要数年时间。

segments.src: Power plants and transmission lines, by contrast, take years to permit and build.
segments.tr: 当需求增长快于供应时，电力就会变得稀缺且昂贵。

segments.src: When demand grows faster than supply, power becomes scarcer and costlier.
segments.tr: 这就是新闻背后的基本经济压力。

segments.src: That is the basic economic pressure behind the headlines.
segments.tr: ## 并非每次价格上涨都是由数据中心引起的

segments.src: ## Not every price increase is caused by data centers
segments.tr: 这里值得谨慎对待。

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: 电费上涨的原因有很多：

segments.src: Electric bills rise for many reasons:
segments.tr: - **天然气价格**，它决定了许多市场的批发电力价格。

segments.src: - **Natural gas prices**, which set wholesale power prices in many markets.
segments.tr: - **老化的基础设施**，电力公司必须对其进行维修或更换。

segments.src: - **Aging infrastructure** that utilities must repair or replace.
segments.tr: - **野火、风暴和韧性支出**，尤其是在一些西部和沿海州。

segments.src: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, especially in some western and coastal states.
segments.tr: - **输电升级**，以连接包括可再生能源在内的新的发电能力。

segments.src: - **Transmission upgrades** to connect new generation, including renewables.
segments.tr: - **劳动力和设备的整体通货膨胀**。

segments.src: - **General inflation** in labor and equipment.
segments.tr: 数据中心需求是众多因素之一，其份额因地而异。

segments.src: Data center demand is one factor among several, and its share differs from place to place.
segments.tr: 来自电网运营商、顾问和消费者权益倡导者的研究，对于它贡献了多少份额得出了不同的结论。

segments.src: Studies from grid operators, consultants and consumer advocates reach different conclusions about how much it contributes.
segments.tr: 对待任何单一数字都应保持谨慎。

segments.src: Treat any single number with caution.
segments.tr: ## 渠道一：容量拍卖

segments.src: ## Channel one: capacity auctions
segments.tr: 在某些地区，电网运营商会举行拍卖，以确保未来几年有足够的发电厂可用，即使它们只在高峰期运行。

segments.src: In some regions, grid operators run auctions to make sure enough power plants will be available in future years, even if they only run at peak times.
segments.tr: 最著名的例子是PJM互联电网（PJM Interconnection），它为从伊利诺伊州到新泽西州的13个州和华盛顿特区提供服务。

segments.src: The best-known example is PJM Interconnection, which serves 13 states and Washington, D.C., from Illinois to New Jersey.
segments.tr: 用简单的话来说，它是这样运作的：

segments.src: Here is how it works in simple terms:
segments.tr: 1. 电网运营商预测未来交付年的峰值需求。

segments.src: 1. The grid operator forecasts peak demand for a future delivery year.
segments.tr: 2. 发电厂所有者和需求响应提供商进行竞标，承诺其可用性。

segments.src: 2. Power plant owners and demand-response providers bid to promise their availability.
segments.tr: 3. 拍卖设定了一个单一的清算价格，通常以“美元/兆瓦日”表示，所有被接受的资源都会获得该价格。

segments.src: 3. The auction sets a single clearing price, usually quoted in dollars per megawatt-day, that all accepted resources receive.
segments.tr: 4. 电力公司以及为客户服务的零售供应商支付这些成本，通常会将其转嫁给客户。

segments.src: 4. Utilities, and the retail suppliers that serve customers, pay those costs and generally pass them through to customers.
segments.tr: 当预测需求上升且供应紧张时，清算价格就会上涨。

segments.src: When forecast demand rises and supply is tight, clearing prices rise.
segments.tr: PJM针对2025/26交付年的拍卖清算价格约为每兆瓦日270美元，高于前一年的约29美元。

segments.src: PJM's auction for the 2025/26 delivery year cleared at roughly $270 per megawatt-day, up from about $29 the year before.
segments.tr: 随后针对2026/27和2027/28年的拍卖，在临时上限和下限安排下以允许的最高价格清算，约为每兆瓦日329美元和333美元。

segments.src: Later auctions for 2026/27 and 2027/28 cleared at the maximum price allowed under a temporary cap-and-floor arrangement, around $329 and $333 per megawatt-day.
segments.tr: PJM和独立市场监察机构已将数据中心负载增长列为预测上升的重要驱动因素。

segments.src: PJM and independent market monitors have cited data center load growth as a significant driver of the higher forecasts.
segments.tr: 由于这些费用随着合同和费率的滚动更新而并入账单，住户通常在拍卖几个月后才会看到影响，而且是分阶段出现的，而不是一次性全部体现。

segments.src: Because these charges are folded into bills as contracts and rates roll over, households often see the effect months after an auction, and in steps rather than all at once.
segments.tr: ## 渠道二：公用事业费率案

segments.src: ## Channel two: utility rate cases
segments.tr: 第二个途径是通过州公用事业监管机构。

segments.src: The second path runs through state utility regulators.
segments.tr: 大多数家庭从受监管的公用事业公司购买电力，其价格在**费率案**（rate case）中确定，这是一项正式程序，公用事业公司在其中请求公共公用事业委员会批准其所需的收入。

segments.src: Most households buy power from a regulated utility whose prices are set in a **rate case**, a formal proceeding in which the utility asks a public utility commission to approve the revenue it needs.
segments.tr: 公用事业公司从他们建设的基础设施中获得受监管的回报，因此新的变电站、输电线路和发电设施会增加收入需求。

segments.src: Utilities earn a regulated return on the infrastructure they build, so new substations, transmission lines and generation can raise the revenue requirement.
segments.tr: 如果公用事业公司是为了满足数据中心的需求而建设，问题就变成了谁来付费：

segments.src: If a utility builds for data center demand, the question becomes who pays:
segments.tr: - 如果数据中心支付为其服务的全部成本，其他客户基本上会受到保护。

segments.src: - If the data center pays for the full cost of serving it, other customers are largely protected.
segments.tr: - 如果成本分摊给所有客户，而预期的数据中心负载延迟、比承诺的小或离开，普通纳税人可能会承担一部分账单。

segments.src: - If costs are spread across all customers, and the expected data center load is delayed, smaller than promised, or leaves, ordinary ratepayers may be stuck with a share of the bill.
segments.tr: 第二种情况是核心担忧。

segments.src: That second scenario is the central worry.
segments.tr: 监管机构称之为**搁浅成本**（stranded costs）的风险，消费者倡导者认为这是一个真实的风险，因为科技公司改变计划的速度比一座使用30年的发电厂退役的速度要快。

segments.src: Regulators call it the risk of **stranded costs**, and consumer advocates argue it is a real risk because tech companies can change plans faster than a 30-year power plant can be retired.
segments.tr: ## 监管机构和各州正在采取的措施

segments.src: ## What regulators and states are doing
segments.tr: 政策制定者已经做出了多种回应，这些方法仍在不断演变。

segments.src: Policymakers have responded in several ways, and the approaches are still evolving.
segments.tr: **针对大用户的特殊费率类别。** 许多州已经批准或正在考虑针对极大型客户的关税。

segments.src: **Special rate classes for large users.** A number of states have approved or are considering tariffs for very large customers.
segments.tr: 典型的特征包括10到20年的长期合同期限、无论客户是否使用电力都适用的最低月度费用（“用或不用都付费”）、退出费以及抵押要求。

segments.src: Typical features include long contract terms of 10 to 20 years, minimum monthly charges that apply whether or not the customer uses the power ("take-or-pay"), exit fees, and collateral requirements.
segments.tr: 俄亥俄州、印第安纳州、佐治亚州、弗吉尼亚州和其他州都朝着这个方向采取了步骤。

segments.src: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia and others have taken steps in this direction.
segments.tr: **要求大用户自带电力。** 一些提议鼓励或要求数据中心资助新的发电设施、签署购电协议或使用现场发电，以便新需求伴随着新供应。

segments.src: **Making large users bring their own power.** Some proposals encourage or require data centers to fund new generation, sign power purchase agreements, or use on-site generation, so that new demand comes with new supply.
segments.tr: **批发市场改革。** 在联邦层面，联邦能源监管委员会一直在审查大负载如何连接到电网以及如何分摊成本，包括在发电厂处共址数据中心。

segments.src: **Wholesale market reforms.** At the federal level, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been examining how large loads connect to the grid and how costs are assigned, including co-location of data centers at power plants.
segments.tr: PJM也一直在修改其拍卖规则和负荷预测，其价格上限和下限是在接到州长的投诉后与州官员协商制定的。

segments.src: PJM has also been revising its auction rules and load forecasting, and its price cap and floor were negotiated with state officials after complaints from governors.
segments.tr: **更好的预测和透明度。** 由于开发商有时会为同一电力提交重叠的请求，监管机构正在要求更坚定的承诺和更清晰的数据，以便公用事业公司不会过度建设。

segments.src: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Because developers sometimes file overlapping requests for the same power, regulators are asking for firmer commitments and clearer data so utilities do not overbuild.
segments.tr: **效率和灵活性。** 一些公用事业公司和研究人员正在探讨数据中心是否可以在高峰时段减少使用，这将缓解压力并减少对新电厂的需求。

segments.src: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Some utilities and researchers are exploring whether data centers can reduce use during peak hours, which would ease strain and reduce the need for new plants.
segments.tr: ## 家庭可以做些什么

segments.src: ## What households can do
segments.tr: 您无法控制容量拍卖，但您可以采取切实可行的步骤：

segments.src: You cannot control a capacity auction, but you can take practical steps:
segments.tr: - **阅读您的账单**，查看供应费、配送费以及任何附加费或附加条款。

segments.src: - **Read your bill** to see the supply charge, delivery charge and any riders or surcharges.
segments.tr: - **检查您是否可以选择供应商。** 在某些州您可以这样做，但要仔细比较价格、合同期限和费用，并注意诱惑性低价。

segments.src: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** In some states you can, but compare the price, contract length and fees carefully, and watch for teaser rates.
segments.tr: - **向您的公用事业公司询问分时电价计划**和能效回扣。

segments.src: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** and efficiency rebates from your utility.
segments.tr: - **做好房屋防风保暖并升级**绝缘材料、恒温器和电器，这无论费率如何都能降低用电量。

segments.src: - **Weatherize and upgrade** insulation, thermostats and appliances, which lowers use regardless of the rate.
segments.tr: - **参与其中。** 公用事业委员会会在费率案上举行公众评论期，来自客户的意见是记录的一部分。

segments.src: - **Participate.** Utility commissions hold public comment periods on rate cases, and comments from customers are part of the record.
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: 人工智能热潮是真实的，它对电力的需求也是如此。

segments.src: The artificial intelligence boom is real, and so is its appetite for electricity.
segments.tr: 它是否会提高家庭账单取决于仍在做出的决定：如何分摊成本、新供应建设的速度有多快，以及多少风险转移到了受益公司身上。

segments.src: Whether it raises household bills depends on decisions still being made: how costs are allocated, how fast new supply is built, and how much risk shifts to the companies that benefit.
segments.tr: 数据中心还可以带来税收、就业机会，并在某些情况下带来惠及所有人的电网投资。

segments.src: Data centers can also bring tax revenue, jobs and, in some cases, grid investment that benefits everyone.
segments.tr: 政策辩论的核心在于确保公平分摊成本和收益。

segments.src: The policy debate is about making sure the costs and benefits are shared fairly.

segments.src: ## Why data centers matter to the grid
segments.tr: ## ग्रिड के लिए डेटा सेंटर क्यों महत्वपूर्ण हैं

segments.src: For about fifteen years, U.S.
segments.tr: लगभग पंद्रह वर्षों के लिए, यू.एस.

segments.src: electricity demand was nearly flat, because efficiency gains offset population and economic growth.
segments.tr: बिजली की मांग लगभग स्थिर थी, क्योंकि दक्षता लाभ ने जनसंख्या और आर्थिक विकास की भरपाई कर दी थी।

segments.src: Utilities and grid operators planned around that stability.
segments.tr: उपयोगिताओं और ग्रिड ऑपरेटरों ने उस स्थिरता के आसपास योजना बनाई।

segments.src: Large data centers break that pattern.
segments.tr: बड़े डेटा सेंटर उस पैटर्न को तोड़ते हैं।

segments.src: A single big campus can require as much power as a small city, and it can ask for that power within a few years.
segments.tr: एक अकेला बड़ा परिसर एक छोटे शहर जितनी बिजली की मांग कर सकता है, और यह कुछ ही वर्षों के भीतर उस बिजली की मांग कर सकता है।

segments.src: Grid planners in several regions, including parts of Virginia, Texas, Ohio, Georgia and the Mid-Atlantic, have sharply raised their demand forecasts.
segments.tr: वर्जीनिया, टेक्सास, ओहियो, जॉर्जिया और मध्य-अटलांटिक के कुछ हिस्सों सहित कई क्षेत्रों में ग्रिड योजनाकारों ने अपने मांग पूर्वानुमानों को काफी बढ़ा दिया है।

segments.src: Power plants and transmission lines, by contrast, take years to permit and build.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत, बिजली संयंत्रों और ट्रांसमिशन लाइनों को अनुमति मिलने और बनाने में कई साल लगते हैं।

segments.src: When demand grows faster than supply, power becomes scarcer and costlier.
segments.tr: जब मांग आपूर्ति की तुलना में तेजी से बढ़ती है, तो बिजली दुर्लभ और अधिक महंगी हो जाती है।

segments.src: That is the basic economic pressure behind the headlines.
segments.tr: यह सुर्खियों के पीछे का मूल आर्थिक दबाव है।

segments.src: ## Not every price increase is caused by data centers
segments.tr: ## हर कीमत में वृद्धि डेटा सेंटरों के कारण नहीं होती है

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: यहाँ सावधान रहना उचित है।

segments.src: Electric bills rise for many reasons:
segments.tr: बिजली के बिल कई कारणों से बढ़ते हैं:

segments.src: - **Natural gas prices**, which set wholesale power prices in many markets.
segments.tr: - **Natural gas prices**, जो कई बाजारों में थोक बिजली की कीमतें तय करती हैं।

segments.src: - **Aging infrastructure** that utilities must repair or replace.
segments.tr: - **Aging infrastructure** जिसे उपयोगिताओं को अवश्य सुधारना या बदलना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, especially in some western and coastal states.
segments.tr: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, विशेष रूप से कुछ पश्चिमी और तटीय राज्यों में।

segments.src: - **Transmission upgrades** to connect new generation, including renewables.
segments.tr: - **Transmission upgrades** नए उत्पादन को जोड़ने के लिए, जिसमें नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा शामिल है।

segments.src: - **General inflation** in labor and equipment.
segments.tr: - श्रम और उपकरणों में **General inflation**।

segments.src: Data center demand is one factor among several, and its share differs from place to place.
segments.tr: डेटा सेंटर की मांग कई कारकों में से एक कारक है, और इसका हिस्सा एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर भिन्न होता है।

segments.src: Studies from grid operators, consultants and consumer advocates reach different conclusions about how much it contributes.
segments.tr: ग्रिड ऑपरेटरों, सलाहकारों और उपभोक्ता अधिवक्ताओं के अध्ययन इस बात पर अलग-अलग निष्कर्षों पर पहुंचते हैं कि यह कितना योगदान देता है।

segments.src: Treat any single number with caution.
segments.tr: किसी भी एक संख्या को सावधानी से लें।

segments.src: ## Channel one: capacity auctions
segments.tr: ## चैनल एक: क्षमता नीलामियाँ

segments.src: In some regions, grid operators run auctions to make sure enough power plants will be available in future years, even if they only run at peak times.
segments.tr: कुछ क्षेत्रों में, ग्रिड ऑपरेटर यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए नीलामियां चलाते हैं कि भविष्य के वर्षों में पर्याप्त बिजली संयंत्र उपलब्ध होंगे, भले ही वे केवल पीक समय पर चलते हों।

segments.src: The best-known example is PJM Interconnection, which serves 13 states and Washington, D.C., from Illinois to New Jersey.
segments.tr: सबसे प्रसिद्ध उदाहरण PJM Interconnection है, जो इलिनोइस से न्यू जर्सी तक 13 राज्यों और वाशिंगटन, डी.सी. की सेवा करता है।

segments.src: Here is how it works in simple terms:
segments.tr: यहाँ बताया गया है कि यह सरल शब्दों में कैसे काम करता है:

segments.src: 1. The grid operator forecasts peak demand for a future delivery year.
segments.tr: 1. ग्रिड ऑपरेटर भविष्य के डिलीवरी वर्ष के लिए पीक मांग का पूर्वानुमान लगाता है।

segments.src: 2. Power plant owners and demand-response providers bid to promise their availability.
segments.tr: 2. बिजली संयंत्र के मालिक और मांग-प्रतिक्रिया प्रदाता अपनी उपलब्धता का वादा करने के लिए बोली लगाते हैं।

segments.src: 3. The auction sets a single clearing price, usually quoted in dollars per megawatt-day, that all accepted resources receive.
segments.tr: 3. नीलामी एक एकल समाशोधन मूल्य निर्धारित करती है, जिसे आमतौर पर डॉलर प्रति मेगावाट-दिन में उद्धृत किया जाता है, जो सभी स्वीकृत संसाधनों को प्राप्त होता है।

segments.src: 4. Utilities, and the retail suppliers that serve customers, pay those costs and generally pass them through to customers.
segments.tr: 4. उपयोगिताएँ, और खुदरा आपूर्तिकर्ता जो ग्राहकों की सेवा करते हैं, उन लागतों का भुगतान करते हैं और आम तौर पर उन्हें ग्राहकों तक पहुँचाते हैं।

segments.src: When forecast demand rises and supply is tight, clearing prices rise.
segments.tr: जब पूर्वानुमानित मांग बढ़ती है और आपूर्ति कम होती है, तो समाशोधन मूल्य बढ़ते हैं।

segments.src: PJM's auction for the 2025/26 delivery year cleared at roughly $270 per megawatt-day, up from about $29 the year before.
segments.tr: 2025/26 डिलीवरी वर्ष के लिए PJM की नीलामी लगभग $270 प्रति मेगावाट-दिन पर साफ हुई, जो पिछले वर्ष के लगभग $29 से अधिक थी।

segments.src: Later auctions for 2026/27 and 2027/28 cleared at the maximum price allowed under a temporary cap-and-floor arrangement, around $329 and $333 per megawatt-day.
segments.tr: 2026/27 और 2027/28 के लिए बाद की नीलामियां एक अस्थायी कैप-एंड-फ्लोर व्यवस्था के तहत अनुमति दी गई अधिकतम कीमत पर साफ हुईं, जो लगभग $329 और $333 प्रति मेगावाट-दिन थी।

segments.src: PJM and independent market monitors have cited data center load growth as a significant driver of the higher forecasts.
segments.tr: PJM और स्वतंत्र बाजार निगरानीकर्ताओं ने उच्च पूर्वानुमानों के एक महत्वपूर्ण चालक के रूप में डेटा सेंटर लोड वृद्धि का हवाला दिया है।

segments.src: Because these charges are folded into bills as contracts and rates roll over, households often see the effect months after an auction, and in steps rather than all at once.
segments.tr: चूंकि ये शुल्क अनुबंधों और दरों के रोलओवर के रूप में बिलों में मुड़े होते हैं, इसलिए परिवार अक्सर नीलामी के महीनों बाद प्रभाव देखते हैं, और एक बार में सब कुछ होने के बजाय चरणों में देखते हैं।

segments.src: ## Channel two: utility rate cases
segments.tr: ## चैनल दो: उपयोगिता दर के मामले

segments.src: The second path runs through state utility regulators.
segments.tr: दूसरा रास्ता राज्य उपयोगिता नियामकों के माध्यम से चलता है।

segments.src: Most households buy power from a regulated utility whose prices are set in a **rate case**, a formal proceeding in which the utility asks a public utility commission to approve the revenue it needs.
segments.tr: अधिकांश परिवार एक विनियमित उपयोगिता से बिजली खरीदते हैं जिसकी कीमतें एक **rate case** में निर्धारित की जाती हैं, जो एक औपचारिक कार्यवाही है जिसमें उपयोगिता सार्वजनिक उपयोगिता आयोग से उस राजस्व को स्वीकृत करने के लिए कहती है जिसकी उसे आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: Utilities earn a regulated return on the infrastructure they build, so new substations, transmission lines and generation can raise the revenue requirement.
segments.tr: उपयोगिताएँ उनके द्वारा बनाए जाने वाले बुनियादी ढांचे पर एक विनियमित रिटर्न अर्जित करती हैं, इसलिए नए सबस्टेशन, ट्रांसमिशन लाइनें और उत्पादन राजस्व आवश्यकता को बढ़ा सकते हैं।

segments.src: If a utility builds for data center demand, the question becomes who pays:
segments.tr: यदि कोई उपयोगिता डेटा सेंटर की मांग के लिए निर्माण करती है, तो सवाल यह बन जाता है कि भुगतान कौन करता है:

segments.src: - If the data center pays for the full cost of serving it, other customers are largely protected.
segments.tr: - यदि डेटा सेंटर इसकी सेवा की पूरी लागत का भुगतान करता है, तो अन्य ग्राहकों को काफी हद तक सुरक्षित रखा जाता है।

segments.src: - If costs are spread across all customers, and the expected data center load is delayed, smaller than promised, or leaves, ordinary ratepayers may be stuck with a share of the bill.
segments.tr: - यदि लागत सभी ग्राहकों में फैली हुई है, और अपेक्षित डेटा सेंटर लोड में देरी हो रही है, वादे से छोटा है, या छोड़ देता है, तो साधारण दरदाता बिल के एक हिस्से के साथ फंस सकते हैं।

segments.src: That second scenario is the central worry.
segments.tr: यह दूसरा परिदृश्य मुख्य चिंता है।

segments.src: Regulators call it the risk of **stranded costs**, and consumer advocates argue it is a real risk because tech companies can change plans faster than a 30-year power plant can be retired.
segments.tr: नियामक इसे **stranded costs** का जोखिम कहते हैं, और उपभोक्ता अधिवक्ता तर्क देते हैं कि यह एक वास्तविक जोखिम है क्योंकि तकनीकी कंपनियां 30 साल के बिजली संयंत्र के सेवानिवृत्त होने की तुलना में तेजी से योजनाएं बदल सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## What regulators and states are doing
segments.tr: ## नियामक और राज्य क्या कर रहे हैं

segments.src: Policymakers have responded in several ways, and the approaches are still evolving.
segments.tr: नीति निर्माताओं ने कई तरीकों से जवाब दिया है, और दृष्टिकोण अभी भी विकसित हो रहे हैं।

segments.src: **Special rate classes for large users.** A number of states have approved or are considering tariffs for very large customers.
segments.tr: **Special rate classes for large users.** कई राज्यों ने बहुत बड़े ग्राहकों के लिए टैरिफ को मंजूरी दे दी है या विचार कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Typical features include long contract terms of 10 to 20 years, minimum monthly charges that apply whether or not the customer uses the power ("take-or-pay"), exit fees, and collateral requirements.
segments.tr: विशिष्ट विशेषताओं में 10 से 20 वर्षों की लंबी अनुबंध शर्तें, न्यूनतम मासिक शुल्क शामिल हैं जो लागू होते हैं चाहे ग्राहक बिजली का उपयोग करता हो या नहीं ("take-or-pay"), निकास शुल्क और संपार्श्विक आवश्यकताएं।

segments.src: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia and others have taken steps in this direction.
segments.tr: ओहियो, इंडियाना, जॉर्जिया, वर्जीनिया और अन्य ने इस दिशा में कदम उठाए हैं।

segments.src: **Making large users bring their own power.** Some proposals encourage or require data centers to fund new generation, sign power purchase agreements, or use on-site generation, so that new demand comes with new supply.
segments.tr: **Making large users bring their own power.** कुछ प्रस्ताव डेटा सेंटरों को नए उत्पादन को निधि देने, बिजली खरीद समझौतों पर हस्ताक्षर करने, या ऑन-साइट उत्पादन का उपयोग करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित या आवश्यक बनाते हैं, ताकि नई मांग नई आपूर्ति के साथ आए।

segments.src: **Wholesale market reforms.** At the federal level, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been examining how large loads connect to the grid and how costs are assigned, including co-location of data centers at power plants.
segments.tr: **Wholesale market reforms.** संघीय स्तर पर, संघीय ऊर्जा नियामक आयोग इस बात की जांच कर रहा है कि बड़े भार ग्रिड से कैसे जुड़ते हैं और लागत कैसे सौंपी जाती है, जिसमें बिजली संयंत्रों में डेटा सेंटरों का सह-स्थान शामिल है।

segments.src: PJM has also been revising its auction rules and load forecasting, and its price cap and floor were negotiated with state officials after complaints from governors.
segments.tr: PJM अपने नीलामी नियमों और लोड पूर्वानुमान को भी संशोधित कर रहा है, और गवर्नरों की शिकायतों के बाद राज्य अधिकारियों के साथ इसके मूल्य कैप और फ्लोर पर बातचीत की गई थी।

segments.src: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Because developers sometimes file overlapping requests for the same power, regulators are asking for firmer commitments and clearer data so utilities do not overbuild.
segments.tr: **Better forecasting and transparency.** चूंकि डेवलपर्स कभी-कभी एक ही बिजली के लिए ओवरलैपिंग अनुरोध दर्ज करते हैं, इसलिए नियामक दृढ़ प्रतिबद्धताओं और स्पष्ट डेटा मांग रहे हैं ताकि उपयोगिताएँ अधिक निर्माण न करें।

segments.src: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Some utilities and researchers are exploring whether data centers can reduce use during peak hours, which would ease strain and reduce the need for new plants.
segments.tr: **Efficiency and flexibility.** कुछ उपयोगिताएँ और शोधकर्ता यह पता लगा रहे हैं कि क्या डेटा सेंटर पीक घंटों के दौरान उपयोग को कम कर सकते हैं, जिससे तनाव कम होगा और नए संयंत्रों की आवश्यकता कम होगी।

segments.src: ## What households can do
segments.tr: ## परिवार क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: You cannot control a capacity auction, but you can take practical steps:
segments.tr: आप क्षमता नीलामी को नियंत्रित नहीं कर सकते हैं, लेकिन आप व्यावहारिक कदम उठा सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **Read your bill** to see the supply charge, delivery charge and any riders or surcharges.
segments.tr: - आपूर्ति शुल्क, वितरण शुल्क और किसी भी राइडर या सरचार्ज को देखने के लिए **Read your bill**।

segments.src: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** In some states you can, but compare the price, contract length and fees carefully, and watch for teaser rates.
segments.tr: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** कुछ राज्यों में आप कर सकते हैं, लेकिन कीमत, अनुबंध की लंबाई और शुल्क की सावधानीपूर्वक तुलना करें, और टीज़र दरों पर नजर रखें।

segments.src: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** and efficiency rebates from your utility.
segments.tr: - अपनी उपयोगिता से **Ask about time-of-use plans** और दक्षता छूट के बारे में पूछें।

segments.src: - **Weatherize and upgrade** insulation, thermostats and appliances, which lowers use regardless of the rate.
segments.tr: - **Weatherize and upgrade** इन्सुलेशन, थर्मोस्टैट्स और उपकरणों को, जो दर की परवाह किए बिना उपयोग को कम करता है।

segments.src: - **Participate.** Utility commissions hold public comment periods on rate cases, and comments from customers are part of the record.
segments.tr: - **Participate.** उपयोगिता आयोग दर के मामलों पर सार्वजनिक टिप्पणी अवधि आयोजित करते हैं, और ग्राहकों की टिप्पणियां रिकॉर्ड का हिस्सा होती हैं।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: The artificial intelligence boom is real, and so is its appetite for electricity.
segments.tr: कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता की तेजी वास्तविक है, और बिजली के लिए इसकी भूख भी वास्तविक है।

segments.src: Whether it raises household bills depends on decisions still being made: how costs are allocated, how fast new supply is built, and how much risk shifts to the companies that benefit.
segments.tr: क्या यह घरेलू बिलों को बढ़ाता है यह अभी भी बनाए जा रहे निर्णयों पर निर्भर करता है: लागत कैसे आवंटित की जाती है, नई आपूर्ति कितनी तेजी से बनाई जाती है, और कितना जोखिम उन कंपनियों पर स्थानांतरित होता है जो लाभ उठाती हैं।

segments.src: Data centers can also bring tax revenue, jobs and, in some cases, grid investment that benefits everyone.

es.title: Impulsando el auge de la IA: por qué los centros de datos están apareciendo en su factura de electricidad

segments.src: Electricity used to be one of the most predictable lines in a household budget.
segments.tr: La electricidad solía ser una de las partidas más predecibles en el presupuesto familiar.

segments.src: In many parts of the United States, that is changing.
segments.tr: En muchas partes de Estados Unidos, eso está cambiando.

segments.src: Retail power prices have risen faster than general inflation in recent years, and the rapid growth of data centers, the facilities that run cloud computing and artificial intelligence, is one of the reasons analysts and regulators keep pointing to.
segments.tr: Los precios minoristas de la energía han subido más rápido que la inflación general en los últimos años, y el rápido crecimiento de los centros de datos, las instalaciones que ejecutan la computación en la nube y la inteligencia artificial, es una de las razones que los analistas y reguladores señalan constantemente.

segments.src: This explainer walks through how that cost can travel from a server hall to a monthly bill, and what policymakers are doing about it.
segments.tr: Esta explicación recorre cómo ese costo puede viajar desde una sala de servidores hasta una factura mensual, y qué están haciendo los legisladores al respecto.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo es solo para información general y no constituye asesoramiento financiero o legal.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and vary by region and year.*
segments.tr: Las cifras son aproximadas y varían según la región y el año.*

segments.src: ## Why data centers matter to the grid
segments.tr: ## Por qué los centros de datos son importantes para la red

segments.src: For about fifteen years, U.S.
segments.tr: Durante unos quince años, la demanda de electricidad en EE. UU.

segments.src: electricity demand was nearly flat, because efficiency gains offset population and economic growth.
segments.tr: fue casi plana, porque las ganancias en eficiencia compensaron el crecimiento demográfico y económico.

segments.src: Utilities and grid operators planned around that stability.
segments.tr: Las empresas de servicios públicos y los operadores de red planificaron en torno a esa estabilidad.

segments.src: Large data centers break that pattern.
segments.tr: Los grandes centros de datos rompen ese patrón.

segments.src: A single big campus can require as much power as a small city, and it can ask for that power within a few years.
segments.tr: Un solo campus grande puede requerir tanta energía como una ciudad pequeña, y puede solicitar esa energía en pocos años.

segments.src: Grid planners in several regions, including parts of Virginia, Texas, Ohio, Georgia and the Mid-Atlantic, have sharply raised their demand forecasts.
segments.tr: Los planificadores de red en varias regiones, incluidas partes de Virginia, Texas, Ohio, Georgia y el Atlántico Medio, han elevado drásticamente sus pronósticos de demanda.

segments.src: Power plants and transmission lines, by contrast, take years to permit and build.
segments.tr: Las plantas de energía y las líneas de transmisión, por el contrario, tardan años en obtener permisos y construirse.

segments.src: When demand grows faster than supply, power becomes scarcer and costlier.
segments.tr: Cuando la demanda crece más rápido que la oferta, la energía se vuelve más escasa y costosa.

segments.src: That is the basic economic pressure behind the headlines.
segments.tr: Esa es la presión económica básica detrás de los titulares.

segments.src: ## Not every price increase is caused by data centers
segments.tr: ## No todos los aumentos de precios son causados por los centros de datos

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: Vale la pena ser cuidadoso aquí.

segments.src: Electric bills rise for many reasons:
segments.tr: Las facturas de electricidad aumentan por muchas razones:

segments.src: - **Natural gas prices**, which set wholesale power prices in many markets.
segments.tr: - **Precios del gas natural**, que establecen los precios mayoristas de energía en muchos mercados.

segments.src: - **Aging infrastructure** that utilities must repair or replace.
segments.tr: - **Infraestructura envejecida** que las empresas de servicios públicos deben reparar o reemplazar.

segments.src: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, especially in some western and coastal states.
segments.tr: - **Gastos en incendios forestales, tormentas y resiliencia**, especialmente en algunos estados occidentales y costeros.

segments.src: - **Transmission upgrades** to connect new generation, including renewables.
segments.tr: - **Actualizaciones de transmisión** para conectar nueva generación, incluidas las renovables.

segments.src: - **General inflation** in labor and equipment.
segments.tr: - **Inflación general** en mano de obra y equipos.

segments.src: Data center demand is one factor among several, and its share differs from place to place.
segments.tr: La demanda de los centros de datos es un factor entre varios, y su participación difiere de un lugar a otro.

segments.src: Studies from grid operators, consultants and consumer advocates reach different conclusions about how much it contributes.
segments.tr: Los estudios de operadores de red, consultores y defensores del consumidor llegan a conclusiones diferentes sobre cuánto contribuye.

segments.src: Treat any single number with caution.
segments.tr: Trate cualquier número individual con precaución.

segments.src: ## Channel one: capacity auctions
segments.tr: ## Canal uno: subastas de capacidad

segments.src: In some regions, grid operators run auctions to make sure enough power plants will be available in future years, even if they only run at peak times.
segments.tr: En algunas regiones, los operadores de red realizan subastas para asegurarse de que haya suficientes plantas de energía disponibles en los años futuros, incluso si solo funcionan en horas pico.

segments.src: The best-known example is PJM Interconnection, which serves 13 states and Washington, D.C., from Illinois to New Jersey.
segments.tr: El ejemplo más conocido es PJM Interconnection, que sirve a 13 estados y Washington, D.C., desde Illinois hasta Nueva Jersey.

segments.src: Here is how it works in simple terms:
segments.tr: Así es como funciona en términos simples:

segments.src: 1. The grid operator forecasts peak demand for a future delivery year.
segments.tr: 1. El operador de red pronostica la demanda máxima para un año de entrega futuro.

segments.src: 2. Power plant owners and demand-response providers bid to promise their availability.
segments.tr: 2. Los propietarios de plantas de energía y los proveedores de respuesta a la demanda pujan para prometer su disponibilidad.

segments.src: 3. The auction sets a single clearing price, usually quoted in dollars per megawatt-day, that all accepted resources receive.
segments.tr: 3. La subasta establece un precio de compensación único, generalmente cotizado en dólares por megavatio-día, que reciben todos los recursos aceptados.

segments.src: 4. Utilities, and the retail suppliers that serve customers, pay those costs and generally pass them through to customers.
segments.tr: 4. Las empresas de servicios públicos y los proveedores minoristas que sirven a los clientes pagan esos costos y generalmente los trasladan a los clientes.

segments.src: When forecast demand rises and supply is tight, clearing prices rise.
segments.tr: Cuando la demanda pronosticada aumenta y la oferta es ajustada, los precios de compensación suben.

segments.src: PJM's auction for the 2025/26 delivery year cleared at roughly $270 per megawatt-day, up from about $29 the year before.
segments.tr: La subasta de PJM para el año de entrega 2025/26 se cerró en aproximadamente $270 por megavatio-día, frente a unos $29 el año anterior.

segments.src: Later auctions for 2026/27 and 2027/28 cleared at the maximum price allowed under a temporary cap-and-floor arrangement, around $329 and $333 per megawatt-day.
segments.tr: Las subastas posteriores para 2026/27 y 2027/28 se cerraron al precio máximo permitido bajo un acuerdo temporal de tope y suelo, alrededor de $329 y $333 por megavatio-día.

segments.src: PJM and independent market monitors have cited data center load growth as a significant driver of the higher forecasts.
segments.tr: PJM y los monitores de mercado independientes han citado el crecimiento de la carga de los centros de datos como un impulsor significativo de los pronósticos más altos.

segments.src: Because these charges are folded into bills as contracts and rates roll over, households often see the effect months after an auction, and in steps rather than all at once.
segments.tr: Debido a que estos cargos se incorporan a las facturas a medida que los contratos y las tarifas se renuevan, los hogares a menudo ven el efecto meses después de una subasta, y en pasos en lugar de todo a la vez.

segments.src: ## Channel two: utility rate cases
segments.tr: ## Canal dos: casos de tarifas de servicios públicos

segments.src: The second path runs through state utility regulators.
segments.tr: El segundo camino pasa por los reguladores estatales de servicios públicos.

segments.src: Most households buy power from a regulated utility whose prices are set in a **rate case**, a formal proceeding in which the utility asks a public utility commission to approve the revenue it needs.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los hogares compran energía de una empresa de servicios públicos regulada cuyos precios se establecen en un **caso de tarifa**, un procedimiento formal en el que la empresa solicita a una comisión de servicios públicos que apruebe los ingresos que necesita.

segments.src: Utilities earn a regulated return on the infrastructure they build, so new substations, transmission lines and generation can raise the revenue requirement.
segments.tr: Las empresas de servicios públicos obtienen un retorno regulado sobre la infraestructura que construyen, por lo que las nuevas subestaciones, líneas de transmisión y generación pueden aumentar el requisito de ingresos.

segments.src: If a utility builds for data center demand, the question becomes who pays:
segments.tr: Si una empresa de servicios públicos construye para la demanda de los centros de datos, la pregunta es quién paga:

segments.src: - If the data center pays for the full cost of serving it, other customers are largely protected.
segments.tr: - Si el centro de datos paga el costo total de servirlo, otros clientes están en gran medida protegidos.

segments.src: - If costs are spread across all customers, and the expected data center load is delayed, smaller than promised, or leaves, ordinary ratepayers may be stuck with a share of the bill.
segments.tr: - Si los costos se distribuyen entre todos los clientes, y la carga esperada del centro de datos se retrasa, es menor de lo prometido o se va, los contribuyentes ordinarios pueden quedarse con una parte de la factura.

segments.src: That second scenario is the central worry.
segments.tr: Ese segundo escenario es la preocupación central.

segments.src: Regulators call it the risk of **stranded costs**, and consumer advocates argue it is a real risk because tech companies can change plans faster than a 30-year power plant can be retired.
segments.tr: Los reguladores lo llaman el riesgo de **costos varados**, y los defensores del consumidor argumentan que es un riesgo real porque las empresas tecnológicas pueden cambiar sus planes más rápido de lo que una planta de energía de 30 años puede ser retirada.

segments.src: ## What regulators and states are doing
segments.tr: ## Qué están haciendo los reguladores y los estados

segments.src: Policymakers have responded in several ways, and the approaches are still evolving.
segments.tr: Los legisladores han respondido de varias maneras, y los enfoques aún están evolucionando.

segments.src: **Special rate classes for large users.** A number of states have approved or are considering tariffs for very large customers.
segments.tr: **Clases de tarifas especiales para grandes usuarios.** Varios estados han aprobado o están considerando tarifas para clientes muy grandes.

segments.src: Typical features include long contract terms of 10 to 20 years, minimum monthly charges that apply whether or not the customer uses the power ("take-or-pay"), exit fees, and collateral requirements.
segments.tr: Las características típicas incluyen términos de contrato largos de 10 a 20 años, cargos mensuales mínimos que se aplican independientemente de si el cliente usa la energía ("take-or-pay"), tarifas de salida y requisitos de garantía.

segments.src: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia and others have taken steps in this direction.
segments.tr: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia y otros han tomado medidas en esta dirección.

segments.src: **Making large users bring their own power.** Some proposals encourage or require data centers to fund new generation, sign power purchase agreements, or use on-site generation, so that new demand comes with new supply.
segments.tr: **Hacer que los grandes usuarios traigan su propia energía.** Algunas propuestas alientan o requieren que los centros de datos financien nueva generación, firmen acuerdos de compra de energía o utilicen generación en el sitio, para que la nueva demanda venga con nueva oferta.

segments.src: **Wholesale market reforms.** At the federal level, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been examining how large loads connect to the grid and how costs are assigned, including co-location of data centers at power plants.
segments.tr: **Reformas del mercado mayorista.** A nivel federal, la Comisión Federal Reguladora de Energía ha estado examinando cómo las grandes cargas se conectan a la red y cómo se asignan los costos, incluida la co-ubicación de centros de datos en plantas de energía.

segments.src: PJM has also been revising its auction rules and load forecasting, and its price cap and floor were negotiated with state officials after complaints from governors.
segments.tr: PJM también ha estado revisando sus reglas de subasta y pronóstico de carga, y su tope y suelo de precios fueron negociados con funcionarios estatales después de las quejas de los gobernadores.

segments.src: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Because developers sometimes file overlapping requests for the same power, regulators are asking for firmer commitments and clearer data so utilities do not overbuild.
segments.tr: **Mejor pronóstico y transparencia.** Debido a que los desarrolladores a veces presentan solicitudes superpuestas para la misma energía, los reguladores están pidiendo compromisos más firmes y datos más claros para que las empresas de servicios públicos no construyan en exceso.

segments.src: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Some utilities and researchers are exploring whether data centers can reduce use during peak hours, which would ease strain and reduce the need for new plants.
segments.tr: **Eficiencia y flexibilidad.** Algunas empresas de servicios públicos e investigadores están explorando si los centros de datos pueden reducir el uso durante las horas pico, lo que aliviaría la tensión y reduciría la necesidad de nuevas plantas.

segments.src: ## What households can do
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los hogares

segments.src: You cannot control a capacity auction, but you can take practical steps:
segments.tr: Usted no puede controlar una subasta de capacidad, pero puede tomar medidas prácticas:

segments.src: - **Read your bill** to see the supply charge, delivery charge and any riders or surcharges.
segments.tr: - **Lea su factura** para ver el cargo de suministro, el cargo de entrega y cualquier recargo o tarifa adicional.

segments.src: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** In some states you can, but compare the price, contract length and fees carefully, and watch for teaser rates.
segments.tr: - **Verifique si puede elegir un proveedor.** En algunos estados puede hacerlo, pero compare el precio, la duración del contrato y las tarifas cuidadosamente, y esté atento a las tarifas gancho.

segments.src: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** and efficiency rebates from your utility.
segments.tr: - **Pregunte sobre los planes de tiempo de uso** y los reembolsos por eficiencia de su empresa de servicios públicos.

segments.src: - **Weatherize and upgrade** insulation, thermostats and appliances, which lowers use regardless of the rate.
segments.tr: - **Aísle y actualice** el aislamiento, los termostatos y los electrodomésticos, lo que reduce el uso independientemente de la tarifa.

segments.src: - **Participate.** Utility commissions hold public comment periods on rate cases, and comments from customers are part of the record.
segments.tr: - **Participe.** Las comisiones de servicios públicos celebran períodos de comentarios públicos sobre los casos de tarifas, y los comentarios de los clientes son parte del registro.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: The artificial intelligence boom is real, and so is its appetite for electricity.
segments.tr: El auge de la inteligencia artificial es real, y también lo es su apetito por la electricidad.

segments.src: Whether it raises household bills depends on decisions still being made: how costs are allocated, how fast new supply is built, and how much risk shifts to the companies that benefit.
segments.tr: Si aumenta las facturas de los hogares depende de las decisiones que aún se están tomando: cómo se asignan los costos, qué tan rápido se construye nueva oferta y cuánto riesgo se traslada a las empresas que se benefician.

segments.src: Data centers can also bring tax revenue, jobs and, in some cases, grid investment that benefits everyone.
segments.tr: Los centros de datos también pueden traer ingresos fiscales, empleos y, en algunos casos, inversión en la red que beneficia a todos.

segments.src: The policy debate is about making sure the costs and benefits are shared fairly.
segments.tr: El debate político trata sobre asegurarse de que los costos y beneficios se compartan de manera justa.

segments.tr: ## القناة الأولى: مزادات السعة

segments.src: In some regions, grid operators run auctions to make sure enough power plants will be available in future years, even if they only run at peak times.
segments.tr: في بعض المناطق، يدير مشغلو الشبكات مزادات للتأكد من توفر محطات طاقة كافية في السنوات القادمة، حتى لو كانت تعمل فقط في أوقات ذروة الاستهلاك.

segments.src: The best-known example is PJM Interconnection, which serves 13 states and Washington, D.C., from Illinois to New Jersey.
segments.tr: المثال الأكثر شهرة هو PJM Interconnection، الذي يخدم 13 ولاية وواشنطن العاصمة، من إلينوي إلى نيوجيرسي.

segments.src: Here is how it works in simple terms:
segments.tr: إليك كيف يعمل الأمر بعبارات بسيطة:

segments.src: 1. The grid operator forecasts peak demand for a future delivery year.
segments.tr: 1. يتوقع مشغل الشبكة ذروة الطلب لسنة تسليم مستقبلية.

segments.src: 2. Power plant owners and demand-response providers bid to promise their availability.
segments.tr: 2. يقدم أصحاب محطات الطاقة ومقدمو استجابة الطلب عروضاً للعديد عن توفرهم.

segments.src: 3. The auction sets a single clearing price, usually quoted in dollars per megawatt-day, that all accepted resources receive.
segments.tr: 3. يحدد المزاد سعر مقاصة واحد، يُقتبس عادةً بالدولار لكل ميغاوات-يوم، تتلقاه جميع الموارد المقبولة.

segments.src: 4. Utilities, and the retail suppliers that serve customers, pay those costs and generally pass them through to customers.
segments.tr: 4. تدفع المرافق وموردو التجزئة الذين يخدمون العملاء تلك التكاليف وغالباً ما تمريرها إلى العملاء.

segments.src: When forecast demand rises and supply is tight, clearing prices rise.
segments.tr: عندما يرتفع الطلب المتوقع ويصبح العرض شحيحاً، ترتفع أسعار المقاصة.

segments.src: PJM's auction for the 2025/26 delivery year cleared at roughly $270 per megawatt-day, up from about $29 the year before.
segments.tr: تمت مقاصة مزاد PJM لسنة التسليم 2025/26 بحوالي $270 لكل ميغاوات-يوم، مقارنة بحوالي $29 في العام السابق.

segments.src: Later auctions for 2026/27 and 2027/28 cleared at the maximum price allowed under a temporary cap-and-floor arrangement, around $329 and $333 per megawatt-day.
segments.tr: تمت تسوية المزادات اللاحقة لعامي 2026/27 و 2027/28 بأقصى سعر مسموح به بموجب ترتيب مؤقت للحد الأدنى والأقصى، حوالي 329 دولاراً و 333 دولاراً لكل ميجاوات في اليوم.

segments.src: PJM and independent market monitors have cited data center load growth as a significant driver of the higher forecasts.
segments.tr: أشارت PJM ومراقبو السوق المستقلون إلى أن نمو أحمال مراكز البيانات يعد محركاً مهماً للتوقعات الأعلى.

segments.src: Because these charges are folded into bills as contracts and rates roll over, households often see the effect months after an auction, and in steps rather than all at once.
segments.tr: نظراً لأن هذه الرسوم تُدرج في الفواتير مع تجديد العقود والأسعار، غالباً ما ترى الأسر التأثير بعد أشهر من المزاد، وعلى مراحل بدلاً من دفعة واحدة.

segments.src: ## Channel two: utility rate cases
segments.tr: ## القناة الثانية: قضايا أسعار المرافق

segments.src: The second path runs through state utility regulators.
segments.tr: المسار الثاني يمر عبر منظمي المرافق في الولاية.

segments.src: Most households buy power from a regulated utility whose prices are set in a **rate case**, a formal proceeding in which the utility asks a public utility commission to approve the revenue it needs.
segments.tr: تشتري معظم الأسر الطاقة من مرفق خاضع للتنظيم يتم تحديد أسعاره في **قضية سعر**، وهي إجراء رسمي يطلب فيه المرفق من لجنة المرافق العامة الموافقة على الإيرادات التي يحتاجها.

segments.src: Utilities earn a regulated return on the infrastructure they build, so new substations, transmission lines and generation can raise the revenue requirement.
segments.tr: تكسب المرافق عائداً منظماً على البنية التحتية التي تبنيها، لذا فإن المحطات الفرعية وخطوط النقل والتوليد الجديدة يمكن أن ترفع متطلبات الإيرادات.

segments.src: If a utility builds for data center demand, the question becomes who pays:
segments.tr: إذا قامت شركة مرافق بالبناء لتلبية طلب مراكز البيانات، يصبح السؤال هو من يدفع:

segments.src: - If the data center pays for the full cost of serving it, other customers are largely protected.
segments.tr: - إذا دفع مركز البيانات التكلفة الكاملة لخدمته، فإن العملاء الآخرين محميون إلى حد كبير.

segments.src: - If costs are spread across all customers, and the expected data center load is delayed, smaller than promised, or leaves, ordinary ratepayers may be stuck with a share of the bill.
segments.tr: - إذا تم توزيع التكاليف على جميع العملاء، وكان حمل مركز البيانات المتوقع متأخراً أو أصغر مما وُعد به أو غادر، فقد يعلق دافعو الفواتير العاديون بجزء من الفاتورة.

segments.src: That second scenario is the central worry.
segments.tr: هذا السيناريو الثاني هو مصدر القلق الرئيسي.

segments.src: Regulators call it the risk of **stranded costs**, and consumer advocates argue it is a real risk because tech companies can change plans faster than a 30-year power plant can be retired.
segments.tr: يسمي المنظمون ذلك خطر **التكاليف العالقة**، ويجادل المدافعون عن المستهلك بأنه خطر حقيقي لأن شركات التكنولوجيا يمكنها تغيير خططها بشكل أسرع من إمكانية إخراج محطة طاقة عمرها 30 عاماً من الخدمة.

segments.src: ## What regulators and states are doing
segments.tr: ## ما يفعله المنظمون والولايات

segments.src: Policymakers have responded in several ways, and the approaches are still evolving.
segments.tr: استجاب صناع السياسات بعدة طرق، ولا تزال الأساليب في تطور.

segments.src: **Special rate classes for large users.** A number of states have approved or are considering tariffs for very large customers.
segments.tr: **فئات أسعار خاصة للمستخدمين الكبار.** وافقت عدد من الولايات أو تدرس تعريفات للعملاء الكبار جداً.

segments.src: Typical features include long contract terms of 10 to 20 years, minimum monthly charges that apply whether or not the customer uses the power ("take-or-pay"), exit fees, and collateral requirements.
segments.tr: تشمل الميزات النموذجية شروط عقود طويلة تتراوح من 10 إلى 20 عاماً، ورسوماً شهرية دنيا تنطبق سواء استخدم العميل الطاقة أم لا ("الدفع مقابل الاستخدام أو الالتزام بالدفع")، ورسوم خروج، ومتطلبات ضمانات.

segments.src: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia and others have taken steps in this direction.
segments.tr: اتخذت ولايات أوهايو وإنديانا وجورجيا وفيرجينيا وغيرها خطوات في هذا الاتجاه.

segments.src: **Making large users bring their own power.** Some proposals encourage or require data centers to fund new generation, sign power purchase agreements, or use on-site generation, so that new demand comes with new supply.
segments.tr: **جعل المستخدمين الكبار يجلبون طاقتهم الخاصة.** تشجع بعض المقترحات أو تتطلب من مراكز البيانات تمويل توليد جديد، أو توقيع اتفاقيات شراء طاقة، أو استخدام توليد في الموقع، بحيث يأتي الطلب الجديد مع إمدادات جديدة.

segments.src: **Wholesale market reforms.** At the federal level, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been examining how large loads connect to the grid and how costs are assigned, including co-location of data centers at power plants.
segments.tr: **إصلاحات سوق الجملة.** على المستوى الفيدرالي، كانت اللجنة الفيدرالية لتنظيم الطاقة تدرس كيفية اتصال الأحمال الكبيرة بالشبكة وكيفية تخصيص التكاليف، بما في ذلك التواجد المشترك لمراكز البيانات في محطات الطاقة.

segments.src: PJM has also been revising its auction rules and load forecasting, and its price cap and floor were negotiated with state officials after complaints from governors.
segments.tr: قامت PJM أيضاً بمراجعة قواعد المزاد وتوقعات الأحمال الخاصة بها، وتم التفاوض على سقف السعر والحد الأدنى الخاص بها مع مسؤولي الولاية بعد شكاوى من الحكام.

segments.src: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Because developers sometimes file overlapping requests for the same power, regulators are asking for firmer commitments and clearer data so utilities do not overbuild.
segments.tr: **تحسين التنبؤ والشفافية.** نظراً لأن المطورين يقدمون أحياناً طلبات متداخلة لنفس الطاقة، يطلب المنظمون التزامات أكثر صرامة وبيانات أوضح حتى لا تبالغ المرافق في البناء.

segments.src: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Some utilities and researchers are exploring whether data centers can reduce use during peak hours, which would ease strain and reduce the need for new plants.
segments.tr: **الكفاءة والمرونة.** يستكشف بعض المرافق والباحثين ما إذا كان بإمكان مراكز البيانات تقليل الاستخدام خلال ساعات الذروة، مما سيخفف الضغط ويقلل الحاجة إلى محطات جديدة.

segments.src: ## What households can do
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن للأسر فعله

segments.src: You cannot control a capacity auction, but you can take practical steps:
segments.tr: لا يمكنك التحكم في مزاد السعة، ولكن يمكنك اتخاذ خطوات عملية:

segments.src: - **Read your bill** to see the supply charge, delivery charge and any riders or surcharges.
segments.tr: - **اقرأ فاتورتك** لمعرفة رسوم التوريد ورسوم التوصيل وأي رسوم إضافية أو ملاحق.

segments.src: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** In some states you can, but compare the price, contract length and fees carefully, and watch for teaser rates.
segments.tr: - **تحقق مما إذا كان بإمكانك اختيار مورد.** في بعض الولايات يمكنك ذلك، ولكن قارن السعر وطول العقد والرسوم بعناية، واحذر من الأسعار الترويجية.

segments.src: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** and efficiency rebates from your utility.
segments.tr: - **اسأل عن خطط وقت الاستخدام** وخصومات الكفاءة من مرفقك.

segments.src: - **Weatherize and upgrade** insulation, thermostats and appliances, which lowers use regardless of the rate.
segments.tr: - **عزل المنزل وترقيته** من حيث العزل الحراري، ومنظمات الحرارة، والأجهزة، مما يقلل الاستخدام بغض النظر عن السعر.

segments.src: - **Participate.** Utility commissions hold public comment periods on rate cases, and comments from customers are part of the record.
segments.tr: - **شارك.** تعقد لجان المرافق فترات تعليق عامة حول قضايا الأسعار، وتعد تعليقات العملاء جزءاً من السجل.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The artificial intelligence boom is real, and so is its appetite for electricity.
segments.tr: طفرة الذكاء الاصطناعي حقيقية، وكذلك شهيتها للكهرباء.

segments.src: Whether it raises household bills depends on decisions still being made: how costs are allocated, how fast new supply is built, and how much risk shifts to the companies that benefit.
segments.tr: ما إذا كانت ستؤدي إلى رفع فواتير الأسر يعتمد على القرارات التي لا تزال تُتخذ: كيفية تخصيص التكاليف، ومدى سرعة بناء إمدادات جديدة، ومقدار المخاطر التي تتحول إلى الشركات التي تستفيد.

segments.src: Data centers can also bring tax revenue, jobs and, in some cases, grid investment that benefits everyone.
segments.tr: يمكن لمراكز البيانات أيضاً جلب إيرادات ضريبية ووظائف، وفي بعض الحالات، استثمارات في الشبكة تفيد الجميع.

segments.src: The policy debate is about making sure the costs and benefits are shared fairly.
segments.tr: يدور النقاش السياسي حول التأكد من تقاسم التكاليف والفوائد بشكل عادل.

segments.tr: *مصادر تستحق التحقق منها للحصول على أرقام حالية: لجنة المرافق العامة في ولايتك، PJM Interconnection ومراقب السوق المستقل التابع لها، إدارة معلومات الطاقة الأمريكية، واللجنة الفيدرالية لتنظيم الطاقة.*
