fr.title: Alimenter le boum de l'IA : pourquoi les centres de données apparaissent sur votre facture d'électricité

segments.src: Electricity used to be one of the most predictable lines in a household budget.
segments.tr: L'électricité était autrefois l'un des postes les plus prévisibles d'un budget familial.

segments.src: In many parts of the United States, that is changing.
segments.tr: Dans de nombreuses régions des États-Unis, cela est en train de changer.

segments.src: Retail power prices have risen faster than general inflation in recent years, and the rapid growth of data centers, the facilities that run cloud computing and artificial intelligence, is one of the reasons analysts and regulators keep pointing to.
segments.tr: Les prix de l'électricité de détail ont augmenté plus rapidement que l'inflation générale ces dernières années, et la croissance rapide des centres de données, les installations qui font fonctionner le cloud computing et l'intelligence artificielle, est l'une des raisons que les analystes et les régulateurs ne cessent de pointer du doigt.

segments.src: This explainer walks through how that cost can travel from a server hall to a monthly bill, and what policymakers are doing about it.
segments.tr: Cet article explicatif montre comment ce coût peut passer d'une salle de serveurs à une facture mensuelle, et ce que les décideurs politiques font à ce sujet.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Cet article est fourni à titre d'information générale uniquement et ne constitue pas un conseil financier ou juridique.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and vary by region and year.*
segments.tr: Les chiffres sont approximatifs et varient selon la région et l'année.*

segments.src: ## Why data centers matter to the grid
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les centres de données comptent pour le réseau

segments.src: For about fifteen years, U.S.
segments.tr: Pendant environ quinze ans, la demande d'électricité aux États-Unis

segments.src: electricity demand was nearly flat, because efficiency gains offset population and economic growth.
segments.tr: est restée presque stable, car les gains d'efficacité ont compensé la croissance démographique et économique.

segments.src: Utilities and grid operators planned around that stability.
segments.tr: Les services publics et les gestionnaires de réseau ont planifié en fonction de cette stabilité.

segments.src: Large data centers break that pattern.
segments.tr: Les grands centres de données brisent ce schéma.

segments.src: A single big campus can require as much power as a small city, and it can ask for that power within a few years.
segments.tr: Un seul grand campus peut exiger autant d'électricité qu'une petite ville, et il peut demander cette électricité en l'espace de quelques années.

segments.src: Grid planners in several regions, including parts of Virginia, Texas, Ohio, Georgia and the Mid-Atlantic, have sharply raised their demand forecasts.
segments.tr: Les planificateurs de réseau dans plusieurs régions, notamment des parties de la Virginie, du Texas, de l'Ohio, de la Géorgie et du Mid-Atlantic, ont fortement relevé leurs prévisions de demande.

segments.src: Power plants and transmission lines, by contrast, take years to permit and build.
segments.tr: Les centrales électriques et les lignes de transmission, en revanche, prennent des années à être autorisées et construites.

segments.src: When demand grows faster than supply, power becomes scarcer and costlier.
segments.tr: Lorsque la demande croît plus vite que l'offre, l'électricité devient plus rare et plus coûteuse.

segments.src: That is the basic economic pressure behind the headlines.
segments.tr: C'est la pression économique fondamentale derrière les gros titres.

segments.src: ## Not every price increase is caused by data centers
segments.tr: ## Toutes les hausses de prix ne sont pas causées par les centres de données

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: Il convient d'être prudent ici.

segments.src: Electric bills rise for many reasons:
segments.tr: Les factures d'électricité augmentent pour de nombreuses raisons :

segments.src: - **Natural gas prices**, which set wholesale power prices in many markets.
segments.tr: - **Natural gas prices**, qui fixent les prix de l'électricité de gros sur de nombreux marchés.

segments.src: - **Aging infrastructure** that utilities must repair or replace.
segments.tr: - **Aging infrastructure** que les services publics doivent réparer ou remplacer.

segments.src: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, especially in some western and coastal states.
segments.tr: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, en particulier dans certains états de l'ouest et de la côte.

segments.src: - **Transmission upgrades** to connect new generation, including renewables.
segments.tr: - **Transmission upgrades** pour connecter la nouvelle production, y compris les énergies renouvelables.

segments.src: - **General inflation** in labor and equipment.
segments.tr: - **General inflation** de la main-d'œuvre et des équipements.

segments.src: Data center demand is one factor among several, and its share differs from place to place.
segments.tr: La demande des centres de données est un facteur parmi plusieurs, et sa part varie d'un endroit à l'autre.

segments.src: Studies from grid operators, consultants and consumer advocates reach different conclusions about how much it contributes.
segments.tr: Les études menées par les gestionnaires de réseau, les consultants et les associations de consommateurs parviennent à des conclusions différentes quant à sa contribution.

segments.src: Treat any single number with caution.
segments.tr: Traitez tout chiffre unique avec prudence.

segments.src: ## Channel one: capacity auctions
segments.tr: ## Premier canal : les enchères de capacité

segments.src: In some regions, grid operators run auctions to make sure enough power plants will be available in future years, even if they only run at peak times.
segments.tr: Dans certaines régions, les gestionnaires de réseau organisent des enchères pour s'assurer qu'un nombre suffisant de centrales électriques seront disponibles dans les années à venir, même si elles ne fonctionnent qu'aux heures de pointe.

segments.src: The best-known example is PJM Interconnection, which serves 13 states and Washington, D.C., from Illinois to New Jersey.
segments.tr: L'exemple le plus connu est PJM Interconnection, qui dessert 13 états et Washington, D.C., de l'Illinois au New Jersey.

segments.src: Here is how it works in simple terms:
segments.tr: Voici comment cela fonctionne en termes simples :

segments.src: 1. The grid operator forecasts peak demand for a future delivery year.
segments.tr: 1. Le gestionnaire de réseau prévoit la demande de pointe pour une future année de livraison.

segments.src: 2. Power plant owners and demand-response providers bid to promise their availability.
segments.tr: 2. Les propriétaires de centrales électriques et les fournisseurs de réponse à la demande soumettent des offres pour promettre leur disponibilité.

segments.src: 3. The auction sets a single clearing price, usually quoted in dollars per megawatt-day, that all accepted resources receive.
segments.tr: 3. L'enchère fixe un prix de compensation unique, généralement exprimé en dollars par mégawattheure-jour, que toutes les ressources acceptées reçoivent.

segments.src: 4. Utilities, and the retail suppliers that serve customers, pay those costs and generally pass them through to customers.
segments.tr: 4. Les services publics, et les fournisseurs de détail qui desservent les clients, paient ces coûts et les répercutent généralement sur les clients.

segments.src: When forecast demand rises and supply is tight, clearing prices rise.
segments.tr: Lorsque la demande prévue augmente et que l'offre est tendue, les prix de compensation augmentent.

segments.src: PJM's auction for the 2025/26 delivery year cleared at roughly $270 per megawatt-day, up from about $29 the year before.
segments.tr: L'enchère de PJM pour l'année de livraison 2025/26 s'est soldée par environ $270 par mégawattheure-jour, contre environ $29 l'année précédente.

segments.src: Later auctions for 2026/27 and 2027/28 cleared at the maximum price allowed under a temporary cap-and-floor arrangement, around $329 and $333 per megawatt-day.
segments.tr: Les enchères ultérieures pour 2026/27 et 2027/28 ont été conclues au prix maximum autorisé dans le cadre d'un arrangement temporaire de plafonnement et de plancher, autour de $329 et $333 par mégawattheure-jour.

segments.src: PJM and independent market monitors have cited data center load growth as a significant driver of the higher forecasts.
segments.tr: PJM et les moniteurs de marché indépendants ont cité la croissance de la charge des centres de données comme un moteur important des prévisions plus élevées.

segments.src: Because these charges are folded into bills as contracts and rates roll over, households often see the effect months after an auction, and in steps rather than all at once.
segments.tr: Parce que ces frais sont intégrés dans les factures au fur et à mesure du renouvellement des contrats et des tarifs, les ménages voient souvent l'effet des mois après une enchère, et par étapes plutôt que tout en même temps.

segments.src: ## Channel two: utility rate cases
segments.tr: ## Deuxième canal : les dossiers tarifaires des services publics

segments.src: The second path runs through state utility regulators.
segments.tr: La deuxième voie passe par les régulateurs des services publics des états.

segments.src: Most households buy power from a regulated utility whose prices are set in a **rate case**, a formal proceeding in which the utility asks a public utility commission to approve the revenue it needs.
segments.tr: La plupart des ménages achètent de l'électricité auprès d'un service public réglementé dont les prix sont fixés dans le cadre d'une **rate case**, une procédure formelle dans laquelle le service public demande à une commission des services publics d'approuver les revenus dont il a besoin.

segments.src: Utilities earn a regulated return on the infrastructure they build, so new substations, transmission lines and generation can raise the revenue requirement.
segments.tr: Les services publics gagnent un rendement réglementé sur l'infrastructure qu'ils construisent, de sorte que de nouvelles sous-stations, lignes de transmission et de production peuvent augmenter le besoin de revenus.

segments.src: If a utility builds for data center demand, the question becomes who pays:
segments.tr: Si un service public construit pour répondre à la demande des centres de données, la question devient de savoir qui paie :

segments.src: - If the data center pays for the full cost of serving it, other customers are largely protected.
segments.tr: - Si le centre de données paie le coût total de sa desserte, les autres clients sont largement protégés.

segments.src: - If costs are spread across all customers, and the expected data center load is delayed, smaller than promised, or leaves, ordinary ratepayers may be stuck with a share of the bill.
segments.tr: - Si les coûts sont répartis entre tous les clients, et que la charge attendue du centre de données est retardée, plus petite que promis, ou s'en va, les contribuables ordinaires peuvent se retrouver coincés avec une part de la facture.

segments.src: That second scenario is the central worry.
segments.tr: Ce deuxième scénario est la principale préoccupation.

segments.src: Regulators call it the risk of **stranded costs**, and consumer advocates argue it is a real risk because tech companies can change plans faster than a 30-year power plant can be retired.
segments.tr: Les régulateurs appellent cela le risque de **stranded costs**, et les défenseurs des consommateurs soutiennent qu'il s'agit d'un risque réel car les entreprises technologiques peuvent changer leurs plans plus rapidement qu'une centrale électrique de 30 ans ne peut être mise hors service.

segments.src: ## What regulators and states are doing
segments.tr: ## Ce que font les régulateurs et les états

segments.src: Policymakers have responded in several ways, and the approaches are still evolving.
segments.tr: Les décideurs politiques ont réagi de plusieurs manières, et les approches continuent d'évoluer.

segments.src: **Special rate classes for large users.** A number of states have approved or are considering tariffs for very large customers.
segments.tr: **Special rate classes for large users.** Un certain nombre d'états ont approuvé ou envisagent des tarifs pour de très grands clients.

segments.src: Typical features include long contract terms of 10 to 20 years, minimum monthly charges that apply whether or not the customer uses the power ("take-or-pay"), exit fees, and collateral requirements.
segments.tr: Les caractéristiques typiques comprennent des contrats à long terme de 10 à 20 ans, des redevances mensuelles minimales qui s'appliquent que le client utilise ou non l'électricité ("take-or-pay"), des frais de sortie et des exigences de garantie.

segments.src: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia and others have taken steps in this direction.
segments.tr: L'Ohio, l'Indiana, la Géorgie, la Virginie et d'autres ont pris des mesures dans cette direction.

segments.src: **Making large users bring their own power.** Some proposals encourage or require data centers to fund new generation, sign power purchase agreements, or use on-site generation, so that new demand comes with new supply.
segments.tr: **Making large users bring their own power.** Certaines propositions encouragent ou obligent les centres de données à financer de nouvelles productions, à signer des contrats d'achat d'électricité ou à utiliser une production sur site, afin que la nouvelle demande s'accompagne d'une nouvelle offre.

segments.src: **Wholesale market reforms.** At the federal level, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been examining how large loads connect to the grid and how costs are assigned, including co-location of data centers at power plants.
segments.tr: **Wholesale market reforms.** Au niveau fédéral, la Federal Energy Regulatory Commission examine la manière dont les grandes charges se connectent au réseau et dont les coûts sont attribués, y compris la colocalisation de centres de données dans les centrales électriques.

segments.src: PJM has also been revising its auction rules and load forecasting, and its price cap and floor were negotiated with state officials after complaints from governors.
segments.tr: PJM a également révisé ses règles d'enchères et ses prévisions de charge, et son plafond et son plancher de prix ont été négociés avec des responsables étatiques après les plaintes de gouverneurs.

segments.src: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Because developers sometimes file overlapping requests for the same power, regulators are asking for firmer commitments and clearer data so utilities do not overbuild.
segments.tr: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Parce que les développeurs déposent parfois des demandes qui se chevauchent pour la même électricité, les régulateurs demandent des engagements plus fermes et des données plus claires afin que les services publics ne surconstruisent pas.

segments.src: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Some utilities and researchers are exploring whether data centers can reduce use during peak hours, which would ease strain and reduce the need for new plants.
segments.tr: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Certains services publics et chercheurs explorent la possibilité pour les centres de données de réduire leur consommation pendant les heures de pointe, ce qui atténuerait la tension et réduirait le besoin de nouvelles centrales.

segments.src: ## What households can do
segments.tr: ## Ce que les ménages peuvent faire

segments.src: You cannot control a capacity auction, but you can take practical steps:
segments.tr: Vous ne pouvez pas contrôler une enchère de capacité, mais vous pouvez prendre des mesures pratiques :

segments.src: - **Read your bill** to see the supply charge, delivery charge and any riders or surcharges.
segments.tr: - **Read your bill** pour voir les frais de fourniture, les frais de livraison et tous les cavaliers ou suppléments.

segments.src: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** In some states you can, but compare the price, contract length and fees carefully, and watch for teaser rates.
segments.tr: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** Dans certains états, vous le pouvez, mais comparez attentivement le prix, la durée du contrat et les frais, et surveillez les taux d'appel.

segments.src: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** and efficiency rebates from your utility.
segments.tr: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** et les remises sur l'efficacité de votre service public.

segments.src: - **Weatherize and upgrade** insulation, thermostats and appliances, which lowers use regardless of the rate.

segments.src: - **Participate.** Utility commissions hold public comment periods on rate cases, and comments from customers are part of the record.
segments.tr: - **Participate.** Les commissions des services publics organisent des périodes de commentaires publics sur les affaires tarifaires, et les commentaires des clients font partie du dossier.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: The artificial intelligence boom is real, and so is its appetite for electricity.
segments.tr: Le boum de l'intelligence artificielle est bien réel, tout comme son appétit pour l'électricité.

segments.src: Whether it raises household bills depends on decisions still being made: how costs are allocated, how fast new supply is built, and how much risk shifts to the companies that benefit.

segments.src: Data centers can also bring tax revenue, jobs and, in some cases, grid investment that benefits everyone.
segments.tr: Les centres de données peuvent également apporter des recettes fiscales, des emplois et, dans certains cas, des investissements dans le réseau qui profitent à tout le monde.

pt.title: Impulsionando o boom da IA: Por que os data centers estão aparecendo na sua conta de luz

segments.src: Electricity used to be one of the most predictable lines in a household budget.
segments.tr: A eletricidade costumava ser uma das linhas mais previsíveis no orçamento doméstico.

segments.src: In many parts of the United States, that is changing.
segments.tr: Em muitas partes dos Estados Unidos, isso está mudando.

segments.src: Retail power prices have risen faster than general inflation in recent years, and the rapid growth of data centers, the facilities that run cloud computing and artificial intelligence, is one of the reasons analysts and regulators keep pointing to.
segments.tr: Os preços de energia no varejo subiram mais rápido do que a inflação geral nos últimos anos, e o rápido crescimento dos data centers, as instalações que executam computação em nuvem e inteligência artificial, é um dos motivos que analistas e reguladores continuam apontando.

segments.src: This explainer walks through how that cost can travel from a server hall to a monthly bill, and what policymakers are doing about it.
segments.tr: Esta explicação percorre como esse custo pode viajar de um salão de servidores até uma conta mensal, e o que os formuladores de políticas estão fazendo a respeito.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é apenas para informação geral e não constitui aconselhamento financeiro ou jurídico.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and vary by region and year.*
segments.tr: Os números são aproximados e variam de acordo com a região e o ano.*

segments.src: ## Why data centers matter to the grid
segments.tr: ## Por que os data centers são importantes para a rede elétrica

segments.src: For about fifteen years, U.S.
segments.tr: Por cerca de quinze anos, a demanda por eletricidade nos EUA

segments.src: electricity demand was nearly flat, because efficiency gains offset population and economic growth.
segments.tr: ficou praticamente estável, porque os ganhos de eficiência compensaram o crescimento populacional e econômico.

segments.src: Utilities and grid operators planned around that stability.
segments.tr: As concessionárias e os operadores de rede planejaram com base nessa estabilidade.

segments.src: Large data centers break that pattern.
segments.tr: Grandes data centers quebram esse padrão.

segments.src: A single big campus can require as much power as a small city, and it can ask for that power within a few years.
segments.tr: Um único grande campus pode exigir tanta energia quanto uma pequena cidade, e pode solicitar essa energia dentro de alguns anos.

segments.src: Grid planners in several regions, including parts of Virginia, Texas, Ohio, Georgia and the Mid-Atlantic, have sharply raised their demand forecasts.
segments.tr: Os planejadores de rede em várias regiões, incluindo partes da Virgínia, Texas, Ohio, Geórgia e o Meio-Atlântico, aumentaram drasticamente suas previsões de demanda.

segments.src: Power plants and transmission lines, by contrast, take years to permit and build.
segments.tr: As usinas de energia e as linhas de transmissão, por outro lado, levam anos para serem licenciadas e construídas.

segments.src: When demand grows faster than supply, power becomes scarcer and costlier.
segments.tr: Quando a demanda cresce mais rápido do que a oferta, a energia torna-se mais escassa e mais cara.

segments.src: That is the basic economic pressure behind the headlines.
segments.tr: Essa é a pressão econômica básica por trás das manchetes.

segments.src: ## Not every price increase is caused by data centers
segments.tr: ## Nem todo aumento de preço é causado por data centers

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: Vale a pena ter cuidado aqui.

segments.src: Electric bills rise for many reasons:
segments.tr: As contas de luz aumentam por muitos motivos:

segments.src: - **Natural gas prices**, which set wholesale power prices in many markets.
segments.tr: - **Preços do gás natural**, que definem os preços de energia no atacado em muitos mercados.

segments.src: - **Aging infrastructure** that utilities must repair or replace.
segments.tr: - **Infraestrutura envelhecida** que as concessionárias precisam reparar ou substituir.

segments.src: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, especially in some western and coastal states.
segments.tr: - **Gastos com incêndios florestais, tempestades e resiliência**, especialmente em alguns estados do oeste e costeiros.

segments.src: - **Transmission upgrades** to connect new generation, including renewables.
segments.tr: - **Atualizações de transmissão** para conectar nova geração, incluindo renováveis.

segments.src: - **General inflation** in labor and equipment.
segments.tr: - **Inflação geral** em mão de obra e equipamentos.

segments.src: Data center demand is one factor among several, and its share differs from place to place.
segments.tr: A demanda dos data centers é um fator entre vários, e sua participação difere de lugar para lugar.

segments.src: Studies from grid operators, consultants and consumer advocates reach different conclusions about how much it contributes.
segments.tr: Estudos de operadores de rede, consultores e defensores do consumidor chegam a conclusões diferentes sobre o quanto isso contribui.

segments.src: Treat any single number with caution.
segments.tr: Trate qualquer número único com cautela.

segments.src: ## Channel one: capacity auctions
segments.tr: ## Canal um: leilões de capacidade

segments.src: In some regions, grid operators run auctions to make sure enough power plants will be available in future years, even if they only run at peak times.
segments.tr: Em algumas regiões, os operadores de rede realizam leilões para garantir que usinas de energia suficientes estarão disponíveis nos anos futuros, mesmo que funcionem apenas nos horários de pico.

segments.src: The best-known example is PJM Interconnection, which serves 13 states and Washington, D.C., from Illinois to New Jersey.
segments.tr: O exemplo mais conhecido é a PJM Interconnection, que atende 13 estados e Washington, D.C., de Illinois a Nova Jersey.

segments.src: Here is how it works in simple terms:
segments.tr: Veja como funciona em termos simples:

segments.src: 1. The grid operator forecasts peak demand for a future delivery year.
segments.tr: 1. O operador da rede prevê a demanda de pico para um futuro ano de entrega.

segments.src: 2. Power plant owners and demand-response providers bid to promise their availability.
segments.tr: 2. Proprietários de usinas de energia e provedores de resposta à demanda fazem lances para prometer sua disponibilidade.

segments.src: 3. The auction sets a single clearing price, usually quoted in dollars per megawatt-day, that all accepted resources receive.
segments.tr: 3. O leilão define um preço de compensação único, geralmente cotado em dólares por megawatt-dia, que todos os recursos aceitos recebem.

segments.src: 4. Utilities, and the retail suppliers that serve customers, pay those costs and generally pass them through to customers.
segments.tr: 4. As concessionárias e os fornecedores de varejo que atendem os clientes pagam esses custos e geralmente os repassam aos clientes.

segments.src: When forecast demand rises and supply is tight, clearing prices rise.
segments.tr: Quando a demanda prevista aumenta e a oferta é restrita, os preços de compensação sobem.

segments.src: PJM's auction for the 2025/26 delivery year cleared at roughly $270 per megawatt-day, up from about $29 the year before.
segments.tr: O leilão da PJM para o ano de entrega 2025/26 foi fechado em aproximadamente $270 por megawatt-dia, acima dos cerca de $29 do ano anterior.

segments.src: Later auctions for 2026/27 and 2027/28 cleared at the maximum price allowed under a temporary cap-and-floor arrangement, around $329 and $333 per megawatt-day.
segments.tr: Leilões posteriores para 2026/27 e 2027/28 foram fechados no preço máximo permitido sob um arranjo temporário de teto e piso, cerca de $329 e $333 por megawatt-dia.

segments.src: PJM and independent market monitors have cited data center load growth as a significant driver of the higher forecasts.
segments.tr: A PJM e os monitores de mercado independentes citaram o crescimento da carga dos data centers como um impulsionador significativo das previsões mais altas.

segments.src: Because these charges are folded into bills as contracts and rates roll over, households often see the effect months after an auction, and in steps rather than all at once.
segments.tr: Como essas cobranças são incorporadas às contas à medida que os contratos e as tarifas são renovados, as famílias geralmente veem o efeito meses após um leilão, e em etapas, em vez de tudo de uma vez.

segments.src: ## Channel two: utility rate cases
segments.tr: ## Canal dois: casos de tarifas de concessionárias

segments.src: The second path runs through state utility regulators.
segments.tr: O segundo caminho passa pelos reguladores estaduais de serviços públicos.

segments.src: Most households buy power from a regulated utility whose prices are set in a **rate case**, a formal proceeding in which the utility asks a public utility commission to approve the revenue it needs.
segments.tr: A maioria das famílias compra energia de uma concessionária regulamentada cujos preços são definidos em um **caso de tarifa**, um processo formal no qual a concessionária pede a uma comissão de serviços públicos que aprove a receita de que precisa.

segments.src: Utilities earn a regulated return on the infrastructure they build, so new substations, transmission lines and generation can raise the revenue requirement.
segments.tr: As concessionárias obtêm um retorno regulamentado sobre a infraestrutura que constroem, portanto, novas subestações, linhas de transmissão e geração podem aumentar a necessidade de receita.

segments.src: If a utility builds for data center demand, the question becomes who pays:
segments.tr: Se uma concessionária constrói para a demanda de data centers, a questão torna-se quem paga:

segments.src: - If the data center pays for the full cost of serving it, other customers are largely protected.
segments.tr: - Se o data center paga pelo custo total de atendê-lo, outros clientes estão amplamente protegidos.

segments.src: - If costs are spread across all customers, and the expected data center load is delayed, smaller than promised, or leaves, ordinary ratepayers may be stuck with a share of the bill.
segments.tr: - Se os custos são distribuídos entre todos os clientes, e a carga esperada do data center é atrasada, menor do que o prometido ou sai, os contribuintes comuns podem ficar com uma parte da conta.

segments.src: That second scenario is the central worry.
segments.tr: Esse segundo cenário é a preocupação central.

segments.src: Regulators call it the risk of **stranded costs**, and consumer advocates argue it is a real risk because tech companies can change plans faster than a 30-year power plant can be retired.
segments.tr: Os reguladores chamam isso de risco de **custos irrecuperáveis**, e os defensores do consumidor argumentam que é um risco real porque as empresas de tecnologia podem mudar os planos mais rápido do que uma usina de energia de 30 anos pode ser aposentada.

segments.src: ## What regulators and states are doing
segments.tr: ## O que os reguladores e estados estão fazendo

segments.src: Policymakers have responded in several ways, and the approaches are still evolving.
segments.tr: Os formuladores de políticas responderam de várias maneiras, e as abordagens ainda estão evoluindo.

segments.src: **Special rate classes for large users.** A number of states have approved or are considering tariffs for very large customers.
segments.tr: **Classes tarifárias especiais para grandes usuários.** Vários estados aprovaram ou estão considerando tarifas para clientes muito grandes.

segments.src: Typical features include long contract terms of 10 to 20 years, minimum monthly charges that apply whether or not the customer uses the power ("take-or-pay"), exit fees, and collateral requirements.
segments.tr: As características típicas incluem prazos contratuais longos de 10 a 20 anos, cobranças mensais mínimas que se aplicam independentemente de o cliente usar a energia ("take-or-pay"), taxas de saída e requisitos de garantia.

segments.src: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia and others have taken steps in this direction.
segments.tr: Ohio, Indiana, Geórgia, Virgínia e outros tomaram medidas nessa direção.

segments.src: **Making large users bring their own power.** Some proposals encourage or require data centers to fund new generation, sign power purchase agreements, or use on-site generation, so that new demand comes with new supply.
segments.tr: **Fazendo com que grandes usuários tragam sua própria energia.** Algumas propostas incentivam ou exigem que os data centers financiem nova geração, assinem contratos de compra de energia ou usem geração no local, para que a nova demanda venha com nova oferta.

segments.src: **Wholesale market reforms.** At the federal level, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been examining how large loads connect to the grid and how costs are assigned, including co-location of data centers at power plants.
segments.tr: **Reformas no mercado atacadista.** Em nível federal, a Comissão Federal Reguladora de Energia tem examinado como grandes cargas se conectam à rede e como os custos são atribuídos, incluindo a co-localização de data centers em usinas de energia.

segments.src: PJM has also been revising its auction rules and load forecasting, and its price cap and floor were negotiated with state officials after complaints from governors.
segments.tr: A PJM também tem revisado suas regras de leilão e previsão de carga, e seu teto e piso de preço foram negociados com autoridades estaduais após reclamações de governadores.

segments.src: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Because developers sometimes file overlapping requests for the same power, regulators are asking for firmer commitments and clearer data so utilities do not overbuild.
segments.tr: **Melhor previsão e transparência.** Como os desenvolvedores às vezes apresentam solicitações sobrepostas para a mesma energia, os reguladores estão pedindo compromissos mais firmes e dados mais claros para que as concessionárias não construam em excesso.

segments.src: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Some utilities and researchers are exploring whether data centers can reduce use during peak hours, which would ease strain and reduce the need for new plants.
segments.tr: **Eficiência e flexibilidade.** Algumas concessionárias e pesquisadores estão explorando se os data centers podem reduzir o uso durante os horários de pico, o que aliviaria a tensão e reduziria a necessidade de novas usinas.

segments.src: ## What households can do
segments.tr: ## O que as famílias podem fazer

segments.src: You cannot control a capacity auction, but you can take practical steps:
segments.tr: Você não pode controlar um leilão de capacidade, mas pode tomar medidas práticas:

segments.src: - **Read your bill** to see the supply charge, delivery charge and any riders or surcharges.
segments.tr: - **Leia sua conta** para ver a cobrança de fornecimento, cobrança de entrega e quaisquer taxas adicionais ou sobretaxas.

segments.src: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** In some states you can, but compare the price, contract length and fees carefully, and watch for teaser rates.
segments.tr: - **Verifique se você pode escolher um fornecedor.** Em alguns estados você pode, mas compare o preço, a duração do contrato e as taxas cuidadosamente, e fique atento a tarifas promocionais.

segments.src: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** and efficiency rebates from your utility.
segments.tr: - **Pergunte sobre planos de tempo de uso** e descontos de eficiência da sua concessionária.

segments.src: - **Weatherize and upgrade** insulation, thermostats and appliances, which lowers use regardless of the rate.
segments.tr: - **Weatherize e atualize** isolamento, termostatos e eletrodomésticos, o que reduz o uso independentemente da tarifa.

segments.src: - **Participate.** Utility commissions hold public comment periods on rate cases, and comments from customers are part of the record.
segments.tr: - **Participe.** As comissões de serviços públicos realizam períodos de comentários públicos sobre casos de tarifas, e os comentários dos clientes fazem parte do registro.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: The artificial intelligence boom is real, and so is its appetite for electricity.
segments.tr: O boom da inteligência artificial é real, e também é seu apetite por eletricidade.

segments.src: Whether it raises household bills depends on decisions still being made: how costs are allocated, how fast new supply is built, and how much risk shifts to the companies that benefit.
segments.tr: Se isso aumenta as contas domésticas depende de decisões que ainda estão sendo tomadas: como os custos são alocados, quão rápido a nova oferta é construída e quanto risco é transferido para as empresas que se beneficiam.

segments.src: Data centers can also bring tax revenue, jobs and, in some cases, grid investment that benefits everyone.
segments.tr: Os data centers também podem trazer receita fiscal, empregos e, em alguns casos, investimento na rede que beneficia a todos.

segments.src: The policy debate is about making sure the costs and benefits are shared fairly.

segments.tr: Sebaliknya, pembangkit listrik dan jalur transmisi membutuhkan waktu bertahun-tahun untuk mendapatkan izin dan dibangun.

segments.src: When demand grows faster than supply, power becomes scarcer and costlier.
segments.tr: Ketika permintaan tumbuh lebih cepat daripada pasokan, listrik menjadi lebih langka dan lebih mahal.

segments.src: That is the basic economic pressure behind the headlines.
segments.tr: Itulah tekanan ekonomi dasar di balik berita utama.

segments.src: ## Not every price increase is caused by data centers
segments.tr: ## Tidak semua kenaikan harga disebabkan oleh pusat data

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: Penting untuk berhati-hati di sini.

segments.src: Electric bills rise for many reasons:
segments.tr: Tagihan listrik naik karena berbagai alasan:

segments.src: - **Natural gas prices**, which set wholesale power prices in many markets.
segments.tr: - **Harga gas alam**, yang menentukan harga listrik grosir di banyak pasar.

segments.src: - **Aging infrastructure** that utilities must repair or replace.
segments.tr: - **Infrastruktur yang menua** yang harus diperbaiki atau diganti oleh perusahaan utilitas.

segments.src: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, especially in some western and coastal states.
segments.tr: - **Pengeluaran kebakaran hutan, badai, dan ketahanan**, terutama di beberapa negara bagian barat dan pesisir.

segments.src: - **Transmission upgrades** to connect new generation, including renewables.
segments.tr: - **Peningkatan transmisi** untuk menghubungkan pembangkit baru, termasuk energi terbarukan.

segments.src: - **General inflation** in labor and equipment.
segments.tr: - **Inflasi umum** pada tenaga kerja dan peralatan.

segments.src: Data center demand is one factor among several, and its share differs from place to place.
segments.tr: Permintaan pusat data adalah salah satu faktor di antara beberapa faktor, dan bagiannya berbeda dari satu tempat ke tempat lain.

segments.src: Studies from grid operators, consultants and consumer advocates reach different conclusions about how much it contributes.
segments.tr: Studi dari operator jaringan, konsultan, dan advokat konsumen mencapai kesimpulan yang berbeda tentang seberapa besar kontribusinya.

segments.src: Treat any single number with caution.
segments.tr: Perlakukan setiap angka tunggal dengan hati-hati.

segments.src: ## Channel one: capacity auctions
segments.tr: ## Saluran pertama: lelang kapasitas

segments.src: In some regions, grid operators run auctions to make sure enough power plants will be available in future years, even if they only run at peak times.
segments.tr: Di beberapa wilayah, operator jaringan menjalankan lelang untuk memastikan bahwa pembangkit listrik yang cukup akan tersedia di tahun-tahun mendatang, bahkan jika pembangkit tersebut hanya beroperasi pada waktu puncak.

segments.src: The best-known example is PJM Interconnection, which serves 13 states and Washington, D.C., from Illinois to New Jersey.
segments.tr: Contoh yang paling terkenal adalah PJM Interconnection, yang melayani 13 negara bagian dan Washington, D.C., dari Illinois hingga New Jersey.

segments.src: Here is how it works in simple terms:
segments.tr: Beginilah cara kerjanya dalam istilah sederhana:

segments.src: 1. The grid operator forecasts peak demand for a future delivery year.
segments.tr: 1. Operator jaringan memperkirakan permintaan puncak untuk tahun pengiriman di masa mendatang.

segments.src: 2. Power plant owners and demand-response providers bid to promise their availability.
segments.tr: 2. Pemilik pembangkit listrik dan penyedia respons permintaan menawar untuk menjanjikan ketersediaan mereka.

segments.src: 3. The auction sets a single clearing price, usually quoted in dollars per megawatt-day, that all accepted resources receive.
segments.tr: 3. Lelang menetapkan harga kliring tunggal, biasanya dikutip dalam dolar per megawatt-hari, yang diterima oleh semua sumber daya yang diterima.

segments.src: 4. Utilities, and the retail suppliers that serve customers, pay those costs and generally pass them through to customers.
segments.tr: 4. Perusahaan utilitas, dan pemasok ritel yang melayani pelanggan, membayar biaya tersebut dan umumnya meneruskannya kepada pelanggan.

segments.src: When forecast demand rises and supply is tight, clearing prices rise.
segments.tr: Ketika perkiraan permintaan naik dan pasokan ketat, harga kliring naik.

segments.src: PJM's auction for the 2025/26 delivery year cleared at roughly $270 per megawatt-day, up from about $29 the year before.
segments.tr: Lelang PJM untuk tahun pengiriman 2025/26 kliring pada sekitar $270 per megawatt-hari, naik dari sekitar $29 tahun sebelumnya.

segments.src: Later auctions for 2026/27 and 2027/28 cleared at the maximum price allowed under a temporary cap-and-floor arrangement, around $329 and $333 per megawatt-day.
segments.tr: Lelang selanjutnya untuk 2026/27 dan 2027/28 kliring pada harga maksimum yang diizinkan di bawah pengaturan batas atas dan bawah sementara, sekitar $329 dan $333 per megawatt-hari.

segments.src: PJM and independent market monitors have cited data center load growth as a significant driver of the higher forecasts.
segments.tr: PJM dan pemantau pasar independen telah menyebut pertumbuhan beban pusat data sebagai pendorong utama perkiraan yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Because these charges are folded into bills as contracts and rates roll over, households often see the effect months after an auction, and in steps rather than all at once.
segments.tr: Karena biaya ini dimasukkan ke dalam tagihan saat kontrak dan tarif bergulir, rumah tangga sering kali melihat efeknya beberapa bulan setelah lelang, dan secara bertahap alih-alih sekaligus.

segments.src: ## Channel two: utility rate cases
segments.tr: ## Saluran kedua: kasus tarif utilitas

segments.src: The second path runs through state utility regulators.
segments.tr: Jalur kedua berjalan melalui regulator utilitas negara bagian.

segments.src: Most households buy power from a regulated utility whose prices are set in a **rate case**, a formal proceeding in which the utility asks a public utility commission to approve the revenue it needs.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar rumah tangga membeli daya dari utilitas yang diatur yang harganya ditetapkan dalam **kasus tarif**, proses formal di mana utilitas meminta komisi utilitas publik untuk menyetujui pendapatan yang dibutuhkannya.

segments.src: Utilities earn a regulated return on the infrastructure they build, so new substations, transmission lines and generation can raise the revenue requirement.
segments.tr: Utilitas memperoleh pengembalian yang diatur atas infrastruktur yang mereka bangun, sehingga gardu induk, jalur transmisi, dan pembangkit baru dapat meningkatkan kebutuhan pendapatan.

segments.src: If a utility builds for data center demand, the question becomes who pays:
segments.tr: Jika utilitas dibangun untuk permintaan pusat data, pertanyaannya menjadi siapa yang membayar:

segments.src: - If the data center pays for the full cost of serving it, other customers are largely protected.
segments.tr: - Jika pusat data membayar biaya penuh untuk melayaninya, pelanggan lain sebagian besar dilindungi.

segments.src: - If costs are spread across all customers, and the expected data center load is delayed, smaller than promised, or leaves, ordinary ratepayers may be stuck with a share of the bill.
segments.tr: - Jika biaya disebarkan ke semua pelanggan, dan beban pusat data yang diharapkan tertunda, lebih kecil dari yang dijanjikan, atau pergi, pembayar tarif biasa mungkin terjebak dengan sebagian tagihan.

segments.src: That second scenario is the central worry.
segments.tr: Skenario kedua itulah yang menjadi kekhawatiran utama.

segments.src: Regulators call it the risk of **stranded costs**, and consumer advocates argue it is a real risk because tech companies can change plans faster than a 30-year power plant can be retired.
segments.tr: Regulator menyebutnya sebagai risiko **biaya terdampar**, dan advokat konsumen berpendapat bahwa itu adalah risiko nyata karena perusahaan teknologi dapat mengubah rencana lebih cepat daripada pembangkit listrik berusia 30 tahun dapat dipensiunkan.

segments.src: ## What regulators and states are doing
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dilakukan regulator dan negara bagian

segments.src: Policymakers have responded in several ways, and the approaches are still evolving.
segments.tr: Pembuat kebijakan telah merespons dengan beberapa cara, dan pendekatan tersebut masih berkembang.

segments.src: **Special rate classes for large users.** A number of states have approved or are considering tariffs for very large customers.
segments.tr: **Kelas tarif khusus untuk pengguna besar.** Sejumlah negara bagian telah menyetujui atau sedang mempertimbangkan tarif untuk pelanggan yang sangat besar.

segments.src: Typical features include long contract terms of 10 to 20 years, minimum monthly charges that apply whether or not the customer uses the power ("take-or-pay"), exit fees, and collateral requirements.
segments.tr: Fitur khas meliputi jangka waktu kontrak yang panjang yaitu 10 hingga 20 tahun, biaya bulanan minimum yang berlaku terlepas dari apakah pelanggan menggunakan daya atau tidak ("take-or-pay"), biaya keluar, dan persyaratan jaminan.

segments.src: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia and others have taken steps in this direction.
segments.tr: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia, dan lainnya telah mengambil langkah ke arah ini.

segments.src: **Making large users bring their own power.** Some proposals encourage or require data centers to fund new generation, sign power purchase agreements, or use on-site generation, so that new demand comes with new supply.
segments.tr: **Membuat pengguna besar membawa daya mereka sendiri.** Beberapa proposal mendorong atau mengharuskan pusat data untuk mendanai pembangkit baru, menandatangani perjanjian pembelian daya, atau menggunakan pembangkit di tempat, sehingga permintaan baru datang dengan pasokan baru.

segments.src: **Wholesale market reforms.** At the federal level, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been examining how large loads connect to the grid and how costs are assigned, including co-location of data centers at power plants.
segments.tr: **Reformasi pasar grosir.** Di tingkat federal, Komisi Regulasi Energi Federal telah memeriksa bagaimana beban besar terhubung ke jaringan dan bagaimana biaya dialokasikan, termasuk ko-lokasi pusat data di pembangkit listrik.

segments.src: PJM has also been revising its auction rules and load forecasting, and its price cap and floor were negotiated with state officials after complaints from governors.
segments.tr: PJM juga telah merevisi aturan lelang dan perkiraan bebannya, dan batas harga serta lantai dinegosiasikan dengan pejabat negara bagian setelah keluhan dari para gubernur.

segments.src: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Because developers sometimes file overlapping requests for the same power, regulators are asking for firmer commitments and clearer data so utilities do not overbuild.
segments.tr: **Perkiraan dan transparansi yang lebih baik.** Karena pengembang terkadang mengajukan permintaan yang tumpang tindih untuk daya yang sama, regulator meminta komitmen yang lebih kuat dan data yang lebih jelas agar utilitas tidak membangun secara berlebihan.

segments.src: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Some utilities and researchers are exploring whether data centers can reduce use during peak hours, which would ease strain and reduce the need for new plants.
segments.tr: **Efisiensi dan fleksibilitas.** Beberapa utilitas dan peneliti sedang menjajaki apakah pusat data dapat mengurangi penggunaan selama jam puncak, yang akan mengurangi tekanan dan mengurangi kebutuhan akan pembangkit baru.

segments.src: ## What households can do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dapat dilakukan rumah tangga

segments.src: You cannot control a capacity auction, but you can take practical steps:
segments.tr: Anda tidak dapat mengontrol lelang kapasitas, tetapi Anda dapat mengambil langkah praktis:

segments.src: - **Read your bill** to see the supply charge, delivery charge and any riders or surcharges.
segments.tr: - **Baca tagihan Anda** untuk melihat biaya pasokan, biaya pengiriman, dan pengendara atau biaya tambahan apa pun.

segments.src: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** In some states you can, but compare the price, contract length and fees carefully, and watch for teaser rates.
segments.tr: - **Periksa apakah Anda dapat memilih pemasok.** Di beberapa negara bagian Anda bisa, tetapi bandingkan harga, panjang kontrak, dan biaya dengan hati-hati, dan tonton tarif penggoda.

segments.src: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** and efficiency rebates from your utility.
segments.tr: - **Tanyakan tentang paket waktu penggunaan** dan rabat efisiensi dari utilitas Anda.

segments.src: - **Weatherize and upgrade** insulation, thermostats and appliances, which lowers use regardless of the rate.
segments.tr: - **Cuaca dan tingkatkan** insulasi, termostat, dan peralatan, yang menurunkan penggunaan terlepas dari tarifnya.

segments.src: - **Participate.** Utility commissions hold public comment periods on rate cases, and comments from customers are part of the record.
segments.tr: - **Berpartisipasi.** Komisi utilitas mengadakan periode komentar publik tentang kasus tarif, dan komentar dari pelanggan adalah bagian dari catatan.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The artificial intelligence boom is real, and so is its appetite for electricity.
segments.tr: Ledakan kecerdasan buatan itu nyata, dan begitu juga selera energinya untuk listrik.

segments.src: Whether it raises household bills depends on decisions still being made: how costs are allocated, how fast new supply is built, and how much risk shifts to the companies that benefit.
segments.tr: Apakah itu menaikkan tagihan rumah tangga tergantung pada keputusan yang masih dibuat: bagaimana biaya dialokasikan, seberapa cepat pasokan baru dibangun, dan berapa banyak risiko beralih ke perusahaan yang diuntungkan.

segments.src: Data centers can also bring tax revenue, jobs and, in some cases, grid investment that benefits everyone.
segments.tr: Pusat data juga dapat membawa pendapatan pajak, pekerjaan, dan, dalam beberapa kasus, investasi jaringan yang menguntungkan semua orang.

segments.src: The policy debate is about making sure the costs and benefits are shared fairly.
segments.tr: Perdebatan kebijakan adalah tentang memastikan biaya dan manfaat dibagi secara adil.

segments.tr: かつて電気代は、家計予算の中で最も予測しやすい項目の一つであった。

segments.src: In many parts of the United States, that is changing.
segments.tr: 米国の一部の地域では、その状況が変わりつつある。

segments.src: Retail power prices have risen faster than general inflation in recent years, and the rapid growth of data centers, the facilities that run cloud computing and artificial intelligence, is one of the reasons analysts and regulators keep pointing to.

segments.src: ## Why data centers matter to the grid
segments.tr: ## なぜデータセンターが送電網にとって重要なのか

segments.src: For about fifteen years, U.S.
segments.tr: 約15年間、米国の電力需要はほぼ横ばいであった。

segments.src: electricity demand was nearly flat, because efficiency gains offset population and economic growth.
segments.tr: なぜなら、効率性の向上が人口と経済の成長相殺したからである。

segments.src: Utilities and grid operators planned around that stability.
segments.tr: 電力会社や送電網の運営者は、その安定性を前提に計画を立てていた。

segments.src: Large data centers break that pattern.
segments.tr: 大規模なデータセンターはそのパターンを崩す。

segments.src: A single big campus can require as much power as a small city, and it can ask for that power within a few years.
segments.tr: 単一の巨大キャンパスが小都市と同等の電力を必要とする場合があり、その電力を数年以内に要求することがある。

segments.src: Grid planners in several regions, including parts of Virginia, Texas, Ohio, Georgia and the Mid-Atlantic, have sharply raised their demand forecasts.
segments.tr: バージニア州、テキサス州、オハイオ州、ジョージア州、中大西洋岸の一部など、いくつかの地域の送電網計画者は、需要予測を大幅に上方修正している。

segments.src: Power plants and transmission lines, by contrast, take years to permit and build.
segments.tr: 対照的に、発電所や送電線の許認可と建設には何年もかかる。

segments.src: When demand grows faster than supply, power becomes scarcer and costlier.
segments.tr: 需要が供給よりも速く成長すると、電力はより稀少になり、コストが高くなる。

segments.src: That is the basic economic pressure behind the headlines.
segments.tr: それがヘッドラインの背後にある基本的な経済的圧力である。

segments.src: ## Not every price increase is caused by data centers
segments.tr: ## 価格上昇のすべてがデータセンターによって引き起こされているわけではない

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: ここでは慎重になる価値がある。

segments.src: Electric bills rise for many reasons:
segments.tr: 電気料金が上昇する理由は多岐にわたる：

segments.src: - **Natural gas prices**, which set wholesale power prices in many markets.
segments.tr: - **天然ガス価格**：多くの市場で卸電力価格を決定する要因。

segments.src: - **Aging infrastructure** that utilities must repair or replace.
segments.tr: - **老朽化したインフラ**：電力会社が修理または交換しなければならないもの。

segments.src: - **Wildfire, storm and resilience spending**, especially in some western and coastal states.
segments.tr: - **山火事、嵐、レジリエンス関連の支出**：特に一部の西部および沿岸の州において。

segments.src: - **Transmission upgrades** to connect new generation, including renewables.
segments.tr: - **送電網のアップグレード**：再生可能エネルギーを含む新しい発電を接続するため。

segments.src: - **General inflation** in labor and equipment.
segments.tr: - **労働力と設備における一般的なインフレ**。

segments.src: Data center demand is one factor among several, and its share differs from place to place.
segments.tr: データセンターの需要はいくつかの要因の一つであり、その割合は場所によって異なる。

segments.src: Studies from grid operators, consultants and consumer advocates reach different conclusions about how much it contributes.
segments.tr: 送電網運営者、コンサルタント、消費者擁護団体による調査は、それがどれほど寄与しているかについて異なる結論に達している。

segments.src: Treat any single number with caution.
segments.tr: 単一の数値は慎重に扱うべきである。

segments.src: ## Channel one: capacity auctions
segments.tr: ## チャネル1：容量オークション

segments.tr: 一部の地域では、たとえピーク時にしか稼働しなくても、将来の年に十分な発電所が確実に利用できるようにするため、送電網運営者がオークションを実施している。

segments.src: The best-known example is PJM Interconnection, which serves 13 states and Washington, D.C., from Illinois to New Jersey.
segments.tr: 最もよく知られた例は、イリノイ州からニュージャージー州に至る13州とワシントンD.C.にサービスを提供するPJMインターコネクションである。

segments.src: Here is how it works in simple terms:
segments.tr: 簡単な言葉で説明すると仕組みはこうである：

segments.src: 1. The grid operator forecasts peak demand for a future delivery year.
segments.tr: 1. 送電網運営者は、将来の配送年のピーク需要を予測する。

segments.src: 2. Power plant owners and demand-response providers bid to promise their availability.
segments.tr: 2. 発電所の所有者とデマンドレスポンスの提供者が、稼働の可用性を約束して入札する。

segments.src: 3. The auction sets a single clearing price, usually quoted in dollars per megawatt-day, that all accepted resources receive.
segments.tr: 3. オークションは単一のクリアリング価格（通常はメガワット日あたりのドルで表される）を設定し、受け入れられたすべてのリソースがそれを受け取る。

segments.src: 4. Utilities, and the retail suppliers that serve customers, pay those costs and generally pass them through to customers.
segments.tr: 4. 電力会社、および顧客にサービスを提供する小売供給者は、それらのコストを支払い、一般的に顧客に転嫁する。

segments.src: When forecast demand rises and supply is tight, clearing prices rise.
segments.tr: 予測需要が増加し、供給がひっ迫すると、クリアリング価格が上昇する。

segments.src: PJM's auction for the 2025/26 delivery year cleared at roughly $270 per megawatt-day, up from about $29 the year before.
segments.tr: 2025/26年配送年に向けたPJMのオークションは、前年の約29ドルから上昇し、メガワット日あたり約270ドルでクリアした。

segments.src: Later auctions for 2026/27 and 2027/28 cleared at the maximum price allowed under a temporary cap-and-floor arrangement, around $329 and $333 per megawatt-day.
segments.tr: その後の2026/27年および2027/28年のオークションは、一時的な上限・下限アレンジメントの下で認められた最高価格、すなわちメガワット日あたり約329ドルおよび333ドルでクリアした。

segments.src: PJM and independent market monitors have cited data center load growth as a significant driver of the higher forecasts.
segments.tr: PJMおよび独立市場監視機関は、より高い予測の主要な推進力としてデータセンターの負荷増加を挙げている。

segments.src: Because these charges are folded into bills as contracts and rates roll over, households often see the effect months after an auction, and in steps rather than all at once.
segments.tr: これらの料金は契約や料金の更新に伴って請求書に組み込まれるため、家計は通常、オークションの数か月後に、一度にではなく段階的にその影響を目にすることになる。

segments.src: ## Channel two: utility rate cases
segments.tr: ## チャネル2：電力会社料金訴訟

segments.src: The second path runs through state utility regulators.
segments.tr: 2つ目の経路は、州の電力規制当局を経由する。

segments.src: Most households buy power from a regulated utility whose prices are set in a **rate case**, a formal proceeding in which the utility asks a public utility commission to approve the revenue it needs.
segments.tr: ほとんどの家計は規制された電力会社から電力を購入しており、その価格は**料金訴訟（rate case）**、つまり電力会社が公共料金委員会に必要な収益の承認を求める正式な手続きの中で設定される。

segments.src: Utilities earn a regulated return on the infrastructure they build, so new substations, transmission lines and generation can raise the revenue requirement.
segments.tr: 電力会社は構築したインフラに対して規制された利益を得るため、新しい変電所、送電線、発電は必要な収益を引き上げる可能性がある。

segments.src: If a utility builds for data center demand, the question becomes who pays:
segments.tr: 電力会社がデータセンターの需要のために建設を行う場合、誰が支払うのかという問題が生じる：

segments.src: - If the data center pays for the full cost of serving it, other customers are largely protected.
segments.tr: - データセンターがそれを維持するための全額を支払う場合、他の顧客は概ね保護される。

segments.src: - If costs are spread across all customers, and the expected data center load is delayed, smaller than promised, or leaves, ordinary ratepayers may be stuck with a share of the bill.
segments.tr: - コストがすべての顧客に分散され、予想されたデータセンターの負荷が遅れたり、約束より小さかったり、撤退したりした場合、通常の料金負担者が請求書の一部を背負い込むことになるかもしれない。

segments.src: That second scenario is the central worry.
segments.tr: その2つ目のシナリオが中心的な懸念事項である。

segments.src: Regulators call it the risk of **stranded costs**, and consumer advocates argue it is a real risk because tech companies can change plans faster than a 30-year power plant can be retired.
segments.tr: 規制当局はこれを**座礁資産コスト（stranded costs）**のリスクと呼び、消費者擁護団体は、ハイテク企業が30年物の発電所が廃止されるよりも速く計画を変更できるため、これは現実的なリスクであると主張している。

segments.src: ## What regulators and states are doing
segments.tr: ## 規制当局と州が行っていること

segments.src: Policymakers have responded in several ways, and the approaches are still evolving.
segments.tr: 政策立案者はいくつかの方法で対応しており、アプローチは今も進化し続けている。

segments.src: **Special rate classes for large users.** A number of states have approved or are considering tariffs for very large customers.
segments.tr: **大口利用者向けの特別料金クラス。** 多くの州が、非常に大口の顧客向けの関税を承認しているか、検討している。

segments.src: Typical features include long contract terms of 10 to 20 years, minimum monthly charges that apply whether or not the customer uses the power ("take-or-pay"), exit fees, and collateral requirements.
segments.tr: 一般的な特徴には、10年から20年の長期契約期間、顧客が電力を使用するかどうかに関わらず適用される最低月額料金（「テイク・オア・ペイ」）、退出手数料、担保要件が含まれる。

segments.src: Ohio, Indiana, Georgia, Virginia and others have taken steps in this direction.
segments.tr: オハイオ州、インディアナ州、ジョージア州、バージニア州などがこの方向に向けた措置を講じている。

segments.src: **Making large users bring their own power.** Some proposals encourage or require data centers to fund new generation, sign power purchase agreements, or use on-site generation, so that new demand comes with new supply.
segments.tr: **大口利用者に自前の電力を持たせること。** 一部の提案では、新しい需要に新しい供給が伴うように、データセンターに新しい発電の資金提供、電力購入契約の締結、またはオンサイト発電の利用を奨励または義務づけている。

segments.src: **Wholesale market reforms.** At the federal level, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been examining how large loads connect to the grid and how costs are assigned, including co-location of data centers at power plants.
segments.tr: **卸売市場の改革。** 連邦レベルでは、連邦エネルギー規制委員会（FERC）が、大口負荷が送電網にどのように接続されるか、またコストがどのように割り当てられるか（発電所へのデータセンターの共同設置を含む）を検討している。

segments.src: PJM has also been revising its auction rules and load forecasting, and its price cap and floor were negotiated with state officials after complaints from governors.
segments.tr: PJMもオークション規則や負荷予測の見直しを行っており、その価格の上限と下限は知事からの苦情を受けて州当局と交渉された。

segments.src: **Better forecasting and transparency.** Because developers sometimes file overlapping requests for the same power, regulators are asking for firmer commitments and clearer data so utilities do not overbuild.
segments.tr: **より良い予測と透明性。** 開発者が同じ電力に対して重複するリクエストを提出することがあるため、規制当局は電力会社が過剰建設を行わないよう、より確実なコミットメントと明確なデータを求めている。

segments.src: **Efficiency and flexibility.** Some utilities and researchers are exploring whether data centers can reduce use during peak hours, which would ease strain and reduce the need for new plants.
segments.tr: **効率性と柔軟性。** 一部の電力会社や研究者は、データセンターがピーク時の使用量を削減できるかどうかを調査しており、これにより負荷が軽減され、新しい発電所の必要性が減少する。

segments.src: ## What households can do
segments.tr: **家計にできること

segments.src: You cannot control a capacity auction, but you can take practical steps:
segments.tr: 容量オークションをコントロールすることはできないが、実践的なステップを踏むことはできる：

segments.src: - **Read your bill** to see the supply charge, delivery charge and any riders or surcharges.
segments.tr: - **請求書を読んで**供給料金、配送料金、およびライダーや追加料金を確認する。

segments.src: - **Check whether you can choose a supplier.** In some states you can, but compare the price, contract length and fees carefully, and watch for teaser rates.
segments.tr: - **サプライヤーを選択できるかどうかを確認する。** 一部の州では可能だが、価格、契約期間、手数料を慎重に比較し、おとり価格（teaser rates）に注意する。

segments.src: - **Ask about time-of-use plans** and efficiency rebates from your utility.
segments.tr: - **電力会社に時間帯別料金プランや効率性リベートについて問い合わせる。**

segments.src: - **Weatherize and upgrade** insulation, thermostats and appliances, which lowers use regardless of the rate.
segments.tr: - **断熱材、サーモスタット、家電製品を断熱改修・アップグレードする**。これにより、料金に関わらず使用量を減らすことができる。

segments.src: - **Participate.** Utility commissions hold public comment periods on rate cases, and comments from customers are part of the record.
segments.tr: - **参加する。** 公共料金委員会は料金訴訟に関する一般からのコメント期間を設けており、顧客からのコメントは記録の一部となる。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The artificial intelligence boom is real, and so is its appetite for electricity.
segments.tr: 人工知能ブームは本物であり、電力に対するその欲求も本物である。

segments.src: Whether it raises household bills depends on decisions still being made: how costs are allocated, how fast new supply is built, and how much risk shifts to the companies that benefit.
segments.tr: それが家計の請求書を引き上げるかどうかは、まだ下されている決定（コストがどのように配分されるか、新しい供給がどれほど速く構築されるか、そしてどれほどのリスクが利益を得る企業に移行するか）にかかっている。

segments.src: Data centers can also bring tax revenue, jobs and, in some cases, grid investment that benefits everyone.
segments.tr: データセンターはまた、税収、雇用、そして場合によってはすべての人に利益をもたらす送電網への投資をもたらすことができる。

segments.src: The policy debate is about making sure the costs and benefits are shared fairly.
segments.tr: 政策論争は、コストと利益が公平に分かち合われるようにすることに関するものである。
